entries.source_title: Model completeness for the differential field of transseries with exponentiation
entries.source_excerpt: We show that the expansion of the valued differential field of logarithmic-exponential transseries by its natural exponential function is model complete. We give an axiomatization of the theory of this expansion that is effective relative to the theory of the real exponential field, and show that any maximal Hardy field satisfies the same axioms. We use this to prove a transfer theorem between Hardy fields and transseries.
entries.title_zh: 含指数函数的 transseries 微分域模型完备性
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明带自然指数函数的对数—指数 transseries 有序微分域扩张是模型完备的，并给出相对于实指数域理论可有效公理化的理论。作者进一步证明任意极大 Hardy 域满足同一组公理，从而建立 Hardy 域与 transseries 之间的迁移定理。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合模型论、渐近分析与微分代数读者，关注形式级数结构与函数域之间的逻辑联系。
entries.pragmatic_review: 模型完备性和迁移结果为 transseries 理论提供结构性进展。

entries.paper_review: 核心定理陈述清楚，公理细节及迁移定理的具体范围需阅读全文。

entries.source_title: Optimal dimension growth rates in the high dimensional Central Limit Theorems
entries.source_excerpt: We investigate the optimal dimension growth rates for the high-dimensional Central Limit Theorem (CLT) over half spaces, Euclidean balls and Borel convex sets, under the existence of fourth moments. It has been observed in the literature that $d=o(n^c)$ with $0< c\leq 1/2$ is sufficient for the CLT to hold over Euclidean balls. As a consequence, the CLT over half spaces should ideally hold under similar dimension growth rates. In case of Borel convex sets, however $d= o(n^{c})$ with $0< c\leq 2/5$ is generally sufficient. The most recent results for CLT over Euclidean balls and Borel convex sets with respective rates $d= o(\sqrt{n})$ and $d= o(n^{2/5})$ is due to Fang and Koike (2024) and under the existence of fourth moments. In this paper, we investigate whether these sufficient growth rates of $d$ with respect to $n$ are also necessary. Thus, our results completely characterize the sharpness of dimension growth rates under existence of fourth moments across half-spaces, Euclidean balls, and Borel convex sets.
entries.title_zh: 高维中心极限定理的最优维数增长率
entries.summary_zh: 论文在仅假设四阶矩存在时，研究高维 CLT 对半空间、欧氏球和一般 Borel 凸集成立所允许的最优维数增长率。针对文献中欧氏球 d=o(√n)、凸集 d=o(n^(2/5)) 等充分条件，作者进一步判断其必要性并给出三类集合下增长率尖锐性刻画。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合高维概率与统计推断研究者判断维度增长时 CLT 何时仍可靠。

entries.paper_review: 摘要明确给出研究对象、矩条件及与既有界的关系。

entries.summary_zh: 该数据集把 OpenAI 的 openai/math 数学问题移植为 Harbor 环境，369 个任务的官方证明已在所述环境中由 oracle 端到端验证；原发布中的 405 条 Lean 陈述有 36 条未纳入，原因包括依赖缺失、内存不足或验证未完成。任务要求智能体在 Lean 4 与预构建 Mathlib 沙箱中补全证明，并由独立沙箱中的 Lean 内核检查精确陈述。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 对研究 Lean 定理证明智能体、基准构造或奖励判定的人有直接价值，尤其值得关注其严格验证规则和未纳入任务的记录；运行成本和判分限制也应纳入实验设计。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可用于 Harbor 智能体的定理证明实验，但每个任务需要较多计算资源，且需配置 Daytona 与模型凭据。
entries.cynic_review: 严格匹配原陈述让判分更明确，却会把等价表述、部分进展和有缺口的策略一律记为零，限制了它作为开放式数学研究信号的代表性。
entries.paper_review: 材料给出任务数、验证规则、官方证明的 oracle 结果及失败分类，证据较具体，但本摘录仍不是对数据集或其证明的独立复核。

project_insight.translation_zh: 这是将 OpenAI 发布的 openai/math 问题移植为 Harbor 环境的数据集。发布说明称，原发布将 405 个结果形式化为 Lean 陈述；本数据集包含其中 369 个环境，其官方证明已在相应环境中端到端验证，覆盖 17 个领域的 214 个结果族。任务要求智能体在无网络的 Lean 4 与预构建 Mathlib 沙箱中补全缺失证明，随后由新的沙箱检查证明是否对应完全相同的原陈述、没有遗留 sorry 或新增公理，并被 Lean 内核接受。项目标注 Apache-2.0，并另列 openai/math 的许可与归属文件。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 一组用于 Harbor 的 Lean 4 定理证明任务，以精确陈述匹配和 Lean 内核检查作为成功判据。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先阅读数据集的 Validation 与严格奖励说明，挑选少量任务确认 Lean 陈述、依赖和 oracle 状态；按页面要求准备 Harbor 0.24+、Daytona 后端及智能体凭据，并预留约 9 GB 的共享沙箱镜像构建资源和每题所列资源。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 页面明确标注该数据集为实验性，底层研究发布也尚未独立审阅，并建议依赖评分为 1 的证明前先阅读证明。369 个任务之外还有 36 条陈述未验证；任务需 Daytona、智能体凭据、每题 4 CPU/8 GB 内存/10 GB 磁盘且最长 4 小时，页面报告已接受证明的中位验证耗时为 8 分钟。判分要求完全证明原始精确陈述，不奖励等价改写或部分进展。
use_cases_zh: 比较不同代码智能体或模型完成 Lean 4 数学证明任务的能力。
研究形式化证明基准如何设计可复核的奖励与防作弊验证。
用已验证任务测试 Lean 工具链、Mathlib 环境或智能体解题流程。

entries.source_title: On the Proportion of Time that a Conventional Confidence Interval Covers
entries.source_excerpt: The concept of confidence sequences, or `anytime confidence intervals,' has attracted significant interest in recent years. This motivates the question of how well conventional confidence intervals behave when similarly evaluated. We show that this density can also be computed as the stationary distribution of a two-dimensional singular diffusion, one component of which is an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process. entries.title_zh: 传统置信区间覆盖总体均值的时间比例
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究持续采样时，传统固定时点置信区间覆盖总体均值的时间占比如何分布；证明其极限由 Brownian motion 泛函 Z(1) 给出，并利用尺度不变性推导 Z(1) 与 B(1) 联合密度的 PDE。作者还将该密度联系到含 Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 分量的二维奇异扩散，并构造可数值求解 PDE 的近似 Markov 链。

entries.source_title: Schnorr Randomness and Effective Bayesian Consistency and Inconsistency
entries.source_excerpt: We study Doob's Consistency Theorem and Freedman's Inconsistency Theorem from the vantage point of computable probability and algorithmic randomness. We show that the Schnorr random elements of the parameter space are computably consistent, when there is a map from the sample space to the parameter space satisfying many of the same properties as limiting relative frequencies. We show that the generic inconsistency in Freedman's Theorem is effectively comeager, which implies the existence of computable parameters which are not computably consistent. Taken together, this work provides a computability-theoretic solution to Diaconis and Freedman's problem of ``know[ing] for which [parameters] the rule [Bayes' rule] is consistent'', and it strengthens recent similar results of Takahashi on Martin-L\"of randomness in Cantor space.
entries.title_zh: Schnorr 随机性与有效贝叶斯一致/不一致
entries.summary_zh: 论文在可计算概率与算法随机性框架中研究 Doob 一致性定理和 Freedman 不一致性定理。若样本到参数的映射满足类似极限相对频率的条件，参数空间中的 Schnorr 随机点可保证可计算一致性；同时 Freedman 定理中的典型不一致集合被证明为有效 comeager，从而存在不可计算一致性的可计算参数。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合算法随机性、统计学基础及可计算贝叶斯推断研究者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 把随机性等级与贝叶斯一致性条件联系起来，并给出存在性结论。
entries.cynic_review: 假设依赖特定可计算映射和概率结构，尚非一般贝叶斯保证。
entries.paper_review: 摘要明确区分一致与不一致结果，形式定义和与 Martin-Löf 结果的关系需阅读全文。

entries.source_title: The transition between order to disorder in the Sepp\"al\"ainen-Johansson model
entries.source_excerpt: We study the Sepp\"al\"ainen-Johansson model of first-passage percolation along a region of the plane where it moves from an ordered to a disordered phase, represented by a 2nd order discontinuity in its limit shape function. The fluctuations in this transition region are of order one, and we determine that certain limiting statistics are described by Fredholm determinants and are closely related to the largest eigenvalue of the GUE.

entries.source_title: Skew-Symmetric Formulations and Energy-Stable Schemes for Compressible Reactive Flow Equations
entries.source_excerpt: This paper develops skew-symmetric formulations and energy stable finite difference schemes for the reactive Euler and reactive Navier--Stokes equations. By introducing suitable transformed variables, we rewrite the governing equations into skew-symmetric forms and obtain continuous energy estimates by standard integration-by-parts arguments. The proposed formulations extend the skew-symmetric framework for compressible flow equations to reactive systems, where the chemical energy and the species equation must be incorporated into the transformed variables. Based on these formulations, we construct semi-discrete schemes with summation-by-parts (SBP) operators. The convective terms are discretized by the non-dissipative part of linear upwind SBP operators, while a nonlinear SBP--WENO operator is used only to supply artificial dissipation near discontinuities. For periodic boundary conditions, the resulting schemes satisfy semi-discrete energy estimates consistent with the continuous analysis. entries.source_title: Sample, Mix, or Verify? Allocating Test-Time Compute under Imperfect Verifiers
entries.source_excerpt: A common way to make language models and agents more accurate is to spend more compute at inference time: generate many candidate solutions and submit the one a verifier prefers. Success then requires that some candidate is correct and that the verifier picks it. The first grows predictably with the number of samples; the second does not, because real verifiers (unit tests, majority votes, LLM judges, reward models) accept wrong answers, reject right ones, and make correlated mistakes. With a fixed budget, a practitioner must decide how many samples to draw, which models to draw them from, and how much to spend on verification, and today these choices are made by rules of thumb. We introduce SPLIT, which makes them from a small labelled pilot. It rests on an exact formula for the probability of submitting a correct answer under accept/reject and top-score selection that accounts for varying task difficulty, blind spots shared across models, and correlated repeated verifier calls. entries.source_title: Density Bounds in Hua's Theorem for Prime Squares
entries.source_excerpt: We prove a density version of Hua's theorem in the five-variable case: if $\mathcal P$ is a subset of the primes with relative lower density greater than $0.82$, then every sufficiently large $n\equiv5\pmod{24}$ is a sum of five squares of primes from $\mathcal P$.
entries.title_zh: Hua 素数平方定理的密度版本
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明 Hua 定理的五变量密度版本：若素数子集 P 的相对下密度大于 0.82，则每个充分大的 n≡5 (mod 24) 都可写成五个来自 P 的素数平方之和。结论保证的是高密度筛选后仍覆盖所有满足同余条件的大整数，不是对任意较稀疏素数子集的表示定理。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合解析数论读者关注加法表示在高密度删选下的稳健性，以及五变量和同余条件的作用。
entries.pragmatic_review: 密度阈值清楚，便于与经典 Hua 定理及其他变量数结果比较。
entries.cynic_review: 需要下密度严格超过 0.82，不能视作对一般素数子集的保证。
entries.paper_review: 摘要给出精确阈值、变量数和同余类，证明方法未在摘要中展开。

entries.source_title: Invariants of big classes from asymptotic total Betti numbers
entries.source_excerpt: We introduce and study a new numerical invariant of big line bundles on normal complex projective varieties, defined in terms of the total Betti number of hypersurfaces associated with high tensor powers of the line bundle. We prove that this invariant is birational and provides an upper bound for the volume of the line bundle. When the big line bundle admits a rational Zariski decomposition, we show that the invariant coincides with the volume. In particular, this holds when the line bundle is ample or is defined on a projective surface. We also investigate the analogous problem in the real algebraic setting, proving the existence of real algebraic hypersurfaces associated with high tensor powers of a big line bundle whose real vanishing loci have arbitrarily large total Betti numbers.

entries.source_title: Spectral asymmetry and odd cycles in integral graphs
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that the triangle $C_3$ is the only integral unicyclic graph with an odd cycle. The main tool is a spectral inequality that does not require integrality: if $G$ is a connected non-bipartite graph and $G-e$ is bipartite for some edge $e$, then the eigenvalues $\lambda_1\ge\cdots\ge\lambda_n$ of $G$ satisfy $\sum_{i}(\lambda_i+\lambda_{n+1-i})^+\le 2$ and $0<\lambda_1+\lambda_n\le 1$. It follows from comparing $A(G)$ with the signed adjacency matrix obtained by reversing the sign of $e$, which is similar to $-A(G)$, through a common rank-one perturbation and Weyl's monotonicity theorem. For integral graphs in this class, an arithmetic lemma then gives $\lambda_n=1-\lambda_1$ and at least $\lambda_1-1\ge1$ triangles, which yields the classification. We also prove that an integral graph of odd girth $g$ has at least $(g-1)!/2$ cycles of length $g$, with equality for the Petersen graph when $g=5$, and we derive consequences for quantum periodicity a
entries.title_zh: 整数图的谱不对称性与奇圈
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明，含奇圈的单圈整数图只有三角形 C₃；核心是一个不要求整数谱的矩阵不等式：若连通非二分图删去某边后变为二分图，其特征值配对和受上界 2 控制，且最大、最小特征值之和介于 0 与 1 之间，再结合整数图的算术性质推出分类。作者还证明奇围长为 g 的整数图至少含有 (g−1)!/2 个长度 g 的圈，g=5 时 Petersen 图达到等号，并讨论其对量子周期性的推论。

entries.source_title: Unconditional Bounds for Two, Three and Four Consecutive Moderate Gaps between Zeros of the Riemann Zeta Function
entries.source_excerpt: We prove unconditional positive-proportion results for consecutive moderate gaps between zeros of the Riemann zeta function. More precisely, for every fixed \(00\). The proof combines Lamzouri's Hilbert-space formulation of the Montgomery--Taylor second-moment method with local spectral estimates for simple critical-line zeros and a cluster-counting argument that accounts for multiple zeros and zeros off the critical line.

entries.source_title: BanglaBBQ: A Bias Benchmark for Question Answering in the Bangladeshi Context
entries.source_excerpt: This paper introduces BanglaBBQ, a question-answering bias benchmark designed to capture stereotypes grounded in the Bangladeshi context, in both Bangla and English. Following KoBBQ and PakBBQ, BanglaBBQ adapts the original Bias Benchmark for Question Answering (BBQ) by classifying its templates into three groups: directly translated (DT), modified to align target groups or contexts with Bangladesh (TM), and removed when deemed unsuitable for the Bangladeshi context (SR). This process retains 140 templates across six categories, comprising 76 DT and 64 TM templates. Five newly authored (NA) categories, based on stereotypes common in Bangladeshi society, are then added: marital status, age and political perception, regional origin, educational background, and mental-health status. Native Bangladeshi annotators judged all 466 newly authored templates, and 372 were retained because a strict majority of English annotators identified the intended target and rated the attitude as common enough. entries.source_title: Almost-optimal bulk regularity conditions in the CLT for G$\beta$E
entries.source_excerpt: We consider linear statistics $\sum_{k=1}^N f(x_k)$ of a Gaussian $\b$-ensemble. Following the work of \cite{LaSo22}, which was concerned only with Wigner matrices, we extend their results for general $\b$. In particular, we show that the CLT holds for any $f \in H^{1/2 + \e}$. The novel input which was not used in \cite{LaSo22} is the Helffer-Sj\"ostrand representation for the covariance, first appearing the random matrix context in \cite{ErYa15}, coupled with characteristic flow estimates for DBM, first appearing in \cite{Bo22}.

entries.source_title: Singular vectors of sparse random rectangular matrices: Transition between delocalized and semilocalized phases
entries.source_excerpt: Consider the bipartite Erd\H{o}s--R\'enyi graph $\mathbb{G}(n,m,d/\sqrt{mn})$ at the critical sparsity $d = b\log(N)$ for some $b > 0$ with $N = n + m$, and constant aspect ratio $\gamma = n/m \geq 1$. We show that the spectrum of its centered and rescaled bi-adjacency matrix, whose limiting law is the Mar\v{c}enko--Pastur (MP) distribution, is split into two phases: in the bulk, singular vectors are completely delocalized, while near the edges, singular vectors are semilocalized, with their mass concentrating on small disjoint balls, centered at vertices with extreme degrees. As $b$ decreases, we identify sharp thresholds for the emergence of outlier singular values. For explicit $b_{\rm R}^{\star}$ and $b_{\rm L}^{\star}$ as functions of $\gamma$, we prove that when $b > b_{\rm R}^{\star}$, there is no outlier outside the bulk; when $b_{\rm L}^{\star}< b < b_{\rm R}^{\star}$, only right outliers emerge; and when $b < b_{\rm L}^{\star}$, outliers are present on both sides, all with high probability. entries.source_title: Generating functions of hypermaps and m-constellations with two alternating boundaries
entries.source_excerpt: We study the enumeration of planar hypermaps with several alternating boundaries. We first derive a peeling recursion with an arbitrary number of alternating boundaries and, in the two- boundary case, translate it into a functional equation for the corresponding generating function. Our main result is an explicit solution of this equation for m-constellations. In particular, we obtain a rational expression for the genus-zero two-point function, or cylinder generating function, with two alternating boundaries.

entries.source_title: Normal approximation for total magnetization in subcritical long-range Ising models
entries.source_excerpt: We establish Berry--Esseen bounds and 1-Wassershtein bounds for the total spin of strictly subcritical zero-field Ising models with summable interactions. For a nonempty finite set $\Lambda\subset\mathbb Z^d$, consider zero-field Gibbs measure with free boundary conditions, in which a spin configuration $\sigma\in\{-1,+1\}^{\Lambda}$ has probability proportional to \[ \exp\!\left\{ \beta\sum_{x,y\in\Lambda} J(x-y)\sigma_x\sigma_y \right\}. \] Let $S_\Lambda:=\sum_{x\in\Lambda}\sigma_x$ be the total spin and $\beta_{\mathrm c}$ denote the critical inverse temperature. For every fixed $0\leq\beta<\beta_{\mathrm c}$, we prove that \[ d_{\mathrm K}\!\left( \frac{S_\Lambda}{\sqrt{\operatorname{Var}(S_\Lambda)}},G \right) \leq C_{\beta,J}|\Lambda|^{-1/2}, \] where $d_{\mathrm K}$ is the Kolmogorov distance, $G\sim \mathcal{N}(0,1)$, and $C_{\beta,J}$ depends only on $\beta$ and $J$. entries.source_title: A technical note on universal formula pcas

entries.source_title: Equivalence of Restricted and Full Division
entries.source_excerpt: We prove over $\mathrm{PA}^{-}$ that the restricted Euclidean division principle $\mathrm{pa17}^{-}$, which asserts division only for co-prime pairs, is equivalent to the full principle $\mathrm{pa17}$. The proof uses a transformation that preserves the quotient in division with remainder to reduce an arbitrary division problem to one for a co-prime pair. This answers Visser's Open Question 8.29 and shows that the restricted principle has the same strength as full Euclidean division over $\mathrm{PA}^{-}$.
entries.title_zh: 受限除法原理与完整除法原理等价
entries.summary_zh: 论文在 PA⁻ 中证明受限 Euclidean 除法原理 pa17⁻（仅对互素数对允许除法）与完整原理 pa17 等价。核心变换保持带余除法中的商，并把任意除法问题归约到互素数对情形，从而回答 Visser 的开放问题 8.29。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合弱算术系统与基础数学研究者关注除法公理的逻辑强度。

entries.source_title: The Segal-Bargmann Transform in Neural Partial Differential Equations
entries.source_excerpt: We introduce a novel neural operator method based on Segal-Bargmann transform and Bargmann-Fock space for learning the solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs). The method brings data encoding, latent-space representation, operator learning, and decoding into an unifed framework. From only finitely many observations, we establish a sup-norm reconstruction error of order $ L^{-\frac{1}{2}} $, where L is the number of complex sampling points that are decoupled with the original samplings and observations. The reconstruction error is independent of the spatial dimension and the number of original sampling points. entries.title_zh: 神经偏微分方程中的 Segal–Bargmann 变换

entries.source_title: Vector bundles on singular surfaces and threefolds
entries.source_excerpt: We fully classify vector bundles of critical rank on normal affine surfaces and threefolds over algebraically closed fields via their Chern classes. We also prove existence of rank $2$ bundles on threefolds with prescribed first and second motivic Chern classes. The main input is the motivic filtration on algebraic $K$-theory: its third piece is generated by smooth closed points and is identified with motivic cohomology by the third Chern class.
entries.title_zh: 奇异曲面与三维簇上的向量丛

entries.source_title: The section conjecture for generic pointed curves
entries.source_excerpt: Let $k/\mathbb Q$ be finitely generated, let $g\geq3$ and $n\geq1$, and let $\mathcal M_{g,n/k}$ be the moduli stack of smooth proper genus-$g$ curves with $n$ distinct ordered markings. Put $K=k(\mathcal M_{g,n/k})$. We prove Grothendieck's section conjecture for the generic $n$-pointed genus-$g$ curve over $K$. Over both the moduli stack and its function field, the continuous sections of the arithmetic fundamental-group extension of the universal complete curve are, up to geometric conjugacy, exactly the $n$ tautological sections. The same classification holds for every geometrically pro-$\ell$ quotient, for every prime $\ell$. Together with Hain's determination of the rational points, these classifications give examples over fields finitely generated over $\mathbb Q$ with any prescribed positive number of rational points for which the full section conjecture holds. The proof builds on Hain's weighted-completion and nonabelian cohomology methods, with a hyperelliptic calculation providing the genus-three input. An integral normalizer lemma and moving-mark arguments pass from unipotent sections to geometrically pro-$\ell$ sections. C
entries.title_zh: 一般带标记曲线的截面猜想
entries.summary_zh: 对数域上有限生成底域 k/Q、亏格 g≥3 且标记数 n≥1 的一般带标记曲线，作者证明 Grothendieck 截面猜想：算术基本群扩张的连续截面在几何共轭下恰由 n 个典范标记截面给出；对每个素数的几何 pro-ℓ 商也成立。结合 Hain 对有理点的刻画，得到可具有任意指定正有理点数且满足完整截面猜想的有限生成域例子。

entries.source_title: Weighted homogeneous surface singularities admitting rational homology disk smoothings
entries.source_excerpt: We study rational homology disk smoothings through canonical-cover representations and specialization of reflexive canonical powers, and recover the known dual graph and analytic classification. The geometric-genus representation of the canonical covering group, together with its complex conjugate, is a direct summand of the reduced regular representation. Specialization forces the canonical Riemann--Roch corrections to vanish; explicit formulas give equations for the Seifert invariants. For three arms and central weight two, these equations, the character restrictions, and the numerical identities determine the Seifert data without assuming the existence of a smoothing. Projective compactifications treat the remaining cases, and elliptic pencils explain the four-arm attachment points and the parameter independence of their cross ratios. We construct strong $\mathbb{Q}$-Gorenstein smoothings for all listed analytic structures by deforming canonical-cover equations and lifting generators of the full first syzygy module. The numerical Milnor formula gives rational homology disk fibers.
entries.title_zh: 允许有理同调盘平滑化的加权齐次曲面奇点
entries.summary_zh: 论文借助典范覆盖表示与反身典范幂的专化研究有理同调盘平滑化，并恢复已知对偶图和解析分类。对三条臂、中心权重为二的情形，方程、特征限制与数值恒等式可在不预设平滑化存在的情况下确定 Seifert 数据；再用射影紧化、椭圆铅笔处理其余情形，并构造强 Q-Gorenstein 平滑化，使 Milnor 纤维成为有理同调盘。

entries.source_title: How Data Scales in Agentic Reinforcement Learning: Laws and Synthesis Strategies
entries.source_excerpt: Pretraining scaling laws treat training data as a one-dimensional quantity: a token count. Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) inherits this scalar abstraction, but modern synthesis pipelines now generate \textit{tasks}, \textit{environments}, and \textit{trajectories} independently and at very different costs, turning data into a structured design space. This raises a question pretraining never had to answer: given a synthesis budget, \textit{which axis} should be scaled? We address this question end-to-end with three tightly coupled contributions. First, we decompose agentic data into three cardinality axes (task, environment, trajectory), plus a reward-density control variable, and fit per-axis scaling relations on different large language models (LLMs) across math+code, SWE, web, and UI/tool application domains. Across all model sizes, model families, domains, and RL algorithms (PPO and GRPO) we measured, the scaling exponents order as environment $>$ task $>$ trajectory. When environment diversity is decomposed into world and environment-structure diversity, its advantage is mainly driven by the former, while the latter is just c
entries.title_zh: 智能体强化学习的数据如何扩展：规律与合成策略
entries.summary_zh: 作者把智能体 RL 数据拆为任务、环境、轨迹三个规模轴，并另设奖励密度变量，跨数学代码、软件工程、网页与 UI 工具任务拟合 scaling relation。所测模型、领域和 PPO/GRPO 算法中，扩展指数排序为环境多样性高于任务数量、高于轨迹数量；环境多样性的收益主要来自世界/场景多样性，而非结构多样性。

entries.source_title: A generalised and modular proof-theoretic semantics for sequent systems
entries.source_excerpt: Base-extension semantics explains logical consequence via derivability in atomic systems. Extending this approach across logics requires careful control of structural principles and contexts. We present a modular sequent-based framework in which support is indexed by multisets of atomic resources and the semantic clauses for connectives are guided by their left introduction rules. The framework separates additive from multiplicative behaviour and makes explicit the contributions of structural rules and restrictions on sequents. We establish soundness and completeness for classical and intuitionistic propositional logic and for multiplicative-additive fragments of classical and intuitionistic linear logic. We then investigate axiomatic extensions of intuitionistic logic through Jankov logic. Two classes of atomic bases yield sound and complete semantics. Completeness is proven using two novel and modular methods using simulation bases, one of which is constructive. These results provide a common semantic treatment of several logical systems while identifying the additional conditions needed to extend the framework beyond structural v
entries.title_zh: 序列演算系统的广义模块化证明论语义
entries.summary_zh: 论文提出一种基于序列演算的模块化语义，把支持关系索引在原子资源的多重集上，并依照联结词的左引入规则定义语义条款，从而明确区分加法式与乘法式行为及结构规则的作用。作者证明该框架对经典与直觉主义命题逻辑，以及经典和直觉主义线性逻辑的乘法—加法片段具有可靠性与完备性；并用两类原子基底研究 Jankov 逻辑扩张，给出两种模块化完备性证明，其中一种是构造性的。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合证明论与非经典逻辑研究者了解不同逻辑系统如何共享一个可组合的语义框架。

entries.source_title: Metric Poissonian Pair Correlation Property Part 1: The Case \(n+\log n\)
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that $(\alpha(n+\log n))_{n\ge1}$ has Poissonian pair correlation for Lebesgue almost every real $\alpha$. This solves a Problem posed by Aistleitner, El-Baz and Munsch [Open Problem 2, Geom. Funct. Anal. 2021].
entries.title_zh: 度量 Poisson 配对相关性（一）：α(n+log n) 序列
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明，对 Lebesgue 几乎所有实数 α，序列 (α(n+log n)) 具有 Poissonian pair correlation，并解决 Aistleitner、El-Baz 与 Munsch 在 2021 年提出的第二个开放问题。此处“几乎所有”排除了一个测度为零的参数集合，结论不是对每个固定 α 的逐点保证。

entries.paper_review: 摘要报告精确的几乎处处结论和所解问题，技术贡献需阅读全文。

entries.source_title: Reasoning with Context Management and External Memory
entries.source_excerpt: Reasoning models maintain information about the status of their reasoning process through in-context memory. Complex problems require larger context windows and memory requirements. In this scenario, context management without caching risks discarding useful information for reasoning. We propose RCMEM, an approach that extends context management with an external memory to maintain additional information without burdening the reasoning model with additional context. RCMEM significantly reduces computation time on problems that require repeated computation of intermediate steps, while achieving better performance on complex problems. We demonstrate our approach on a few mathematics problems using model sizes ranging from 0.4 to 25 million parameters, and GPT-2.
entries.title_zh: 结合上下文管理与外部记忆的推理方法
entries.summary_zh: 论文提出 RCMEM，用外部记忆保存推理状态，减少上下文窗口中重复计算中间步骤时的负担。作者在若干数学问题上测试 0.4 至 25M 参数模型及 GPT-2，报告重复中间计算任务耗时显著下降、复杂问题表现提高；现有摘录未给精确指标或规模更大的模型评估。

entries.source_title: Where Latents Belong and How They Flow: Joint Identification of Structural Roles
entries.source_excerpt: Latent factors in dynamical systems can play different roles across observations and time. For example, an idea in a group meeting may be expressed by only some participants, inherit information from earlier discussions, and shape what is said next. We formalize this notion as the structural role of a latent factor, describing where it is expressed, whether it receives influence from the past, and whether it transmits influence to the future. The main challenge is correspondence, since the three structures may be identified under different permutations, while a structural role is defined only when they are aligned to the same latent coordinate. We show that, under suitable structural and variability conditions, all three roles are jointly identifiable under a common permutation at each time point. Guided by this theory, we develop RoleTrace, a framework that traces structural roles in a shared latent coordinate system. Synthetic experiments validate structural recovery, while experiments on multiparty meetings examine the identified roles in real sequential interactions.
entries.title_zh: 潜变量的位置与流动：结构角色的联合识别
entries.summary_zh: 论文把动态系统中的潜因子结构角色定义为其在哪些观测表达、是否受过去影响、是否影响未来，并处理三种结构识别时潜变量坐标置换不一致的问题。作者证明在合适结构与可变性条件下，三种角色可在每个时间点以同一置换联合识别，并提出 RoleTrace；合成数据测试结构恢复，多人会议序列用于展示应用。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合时序表示学习及社会交互分析读者。

entries.source_title: Multilevel Gaussian Processes with Applications to Inverse Problems
entries.source_excerpt: We present a multilevel Gaussian process (GP) regression framework for approximating functions that are accessible only through a hierarchy of approximations of increasing accuracy and computational cost. One example is the response surface of a parametrized partial differential equation, where the hierarchy arises from the resolution of the numerical solver. Modeling level increments independently with Mat\'ern-kernel GPs and allocating samples flexibly across discretization levels yields substantial computational savings over single-level GP regression. We derive $L^2$ convergence rates for the posterior mean and variance, accounting for maximum likelihood estimation of the marginal variance and for kernel misspecification. When increment regularity or solver cost is unknown a priori, an adaptive sequential-design algorithm with cost-adapted active learning criteria allocates samples across levels. We apply the surrogate to Bayesian inverse problems, for which Hellinger distance bounds between the true and approximate posteriors are known. Numerical experiments illustrate the theoretical rates and the resulting computational savings
entries.title_zh: 多层高斯过程及其逆问题应用
entries.summary_zh: 论文提出多层高斯过程回归，把不同精度、成本的近似层级建模为独立增量，并灵活分配样本；对参数化 PDE 响应面可利用不同网格分辨率降低成本。作者推导后验均值与方差的 L² 收敛率，考虑边际方差极大似然估计及核错设，并给出成本自适应主动学习；在贝叶斯逆问题中利用 Hellinger 距离控制近似后验误差。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合科学计算与贝叶斯反问题读者评估多精度代理模型。

entries.source_title: Computing S(X) for Ruled Surfaces Defined by Stable Bundles on Curves of Genus 2
entries.source_excerpt: This paper discusses the algebra of symmetric tensors for ruled surfaces defined by rank 2 stable vector bundles on curves of genus 2. The algebra is computed for special bundles $E$ when $S^2 E$ is destabilized by a line bundle and when $S^3 E$ is destabilized by a bundle of rank 2. A strategy for computation is discussed in regards to the other special bundles $E$. This paper also discusses the generalization of these strategies to higher genus and gives a computation when $E$ is not stable and may be written as a direct sum of line bundles.
entries.title_zh: 亏格二曲线上稳定丛定义的 ruled surface 对称张量代数
entries.summary_zh: 论文计算由亏格二曲线上的秩二稳定向量丛 E 定义的 ruled surface 对称张量代数 S(X)，重点处理 S²E 被线丛 destabilize，以及 S³E 被秩二向量丛 destabilize 的特殊情形。作者讨论其他特殊稳定丛的计算策略，并将思路推广到更高亏格；对 E 非稳定且可写成线丛直和的情形也给出计算。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合代数几何读者研究向量丛稳定性如何影响 ruled surface 的对称张量代数结构。
entries.pragmatic_review: 对称代数计算可为研究特殊向量丛构造提供案例。

entries.source_title: Stability and Error Estimates for Convolution Quadrature under Radial Symbol Bounds
entries.source_excerpt: We develop stability and error estimates for multistep convolution quadrature (CQ) under general radial bounds on the Laplace symbol. Instead of the classical single-power condition $|F(z)|\leq M|z|^{-\mu}$, we assume $|F(z)|\leq C\Phi(|z|)$ and consider two classes of radial functions: monotone bounds satisfying a scaling condition and regularly varying bounds with locally bounded above and away from zero. For strongly $A(\alpha)$-stable multistep methods, we derive approximation and stability estimates for the CQ weights, as well as error bounds for power-type inputs $g_\beta(t)=t^{\beta-1}/\Gamma(\beta)$ with $\beta>0$. These estimates explicitly retain the dependence on the memory law through the factor $\Phi(t_n^{-1})$. The framework accommodates symbols whose behavior cannot be described by a global single-power. It also preserves slowly varying and multiscale factors that would be lost under a coarser power majorant. The theory is applied to fractional viscoelastic models, distributed-order operators, and logarithmic-power memory operators. Numerical experiments with backward Euler and second-order backward differentiation CQ c

entries.source_title: Proof Perplexity: A Probabilistic Approach to Measuring non-triviality in Machine Generated Proofs
entries.source_excerpt: In this article, we propose a benchmark to quantify the non-triviality and novelty of machine-generated mathematical proofs compared to existing literature. Our core methodology uses a probabilistic measure to evaluate the non-triviality of the underlying mathematical arguments in comparison to the current \texttt{MATHLIB} library. Finally, we apply this benchmark to the recent proof generated by Claude on the complex zeros of the Riemann zeta function to test for non-trivial steps.

entries.source_title: Uncertainty-Aware Budget Allocation for Efficient LLM Tree Search
entries.source_excerpt: Tree search enhances multi-step reasoning in large language models (LLMs), yet prevailing methods expand every step with a fixed budget, irrespective of the marginal utility of expansion. We first show, across existing search algorithms, that continuations sampled from a shared intermediate state are largely duplicates and collapse to a few distinct answers. Critically, we find that the semantic dispersion of sibling actions predicts the redundancy of their downstream continuations, permitting a subtree's budget to be fixed before expansion. An information-theoretic analysis motivates this: treating the per-step budget as the Monte Carlo sample size for estimating a step's residual answer entropy, we derive a sufficient budget that shrinks with sibling dispersion. We accordingly propose $\textbf{Uncertainty-Aware Allocation}$ (UAA), a training-free framework that decouples value from uncertainty: values determine which candidates are promising, while uncertainty, estimated from sibling dispersion at no additional model cost, determines how many merit expansion, via uncertainty-aware pruning and uncertainty-aware budgeting. entries.source_title: Void probabilities for perturbed lattices under mixing
entries.source_excerpt: We study void probabilities for stationary perturbed lattices with possibly dependent perturbations. Our main result gives a general upper bound in terms of two ingredients: the number of lattice sites having a uniformly positive probability of hitting the observation set, and the $\alpha$-mixing rate of the perturbation field. For unions of lattice cubes, this yields explicit bounds without moment or regularity assumptions on the marginal distribution of the perturbations. As a consequence, we obtain quantitative estimates for growing bounded Borel sets with non-empty interior, including stretched-exponential decay under exponential mixing and polynomial decay under polynomial mixing.

entries.title_zh: Reuters：OpenAI 正洽谈约 300 亿美元融资，估值或超 1.4 万亿美元
entries.summary_zh: 转述 Reuters 的消息称，OpenAI 正在筹备约 300 亿美元融资，目标估值超过 1.4 万亿美元，并称相较 3 月的 8520 亿美元估值至少提高 64%。这属于尚在洽谈的融资消息，最终金额、估值和投资者条件可能变化。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合跟踪头部 AI 公司融资与资本市场预期的读者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 金额与估值预期具体，反映市场对算力与增长的押注。
entries.cynic_review: 尚未完成的交易不能当作最终估值或已到账资金。
entries.paper_review: 二手社交媒体转述 Reuters，需等待正式报道或交易文件。

entries.source_title: A hacker broke into John Deere and SharkNinja with an army of AI agents
entries.source_excerpt: AI 安全公司 Norforge 发现一名黑客用开源 AI 平台 Cairn 编排的智能体入侵了超过 100 个网站，据 Reuters 报道受害者包括 John Deere、SharkNinja 和 Cummins。
entries.title_zh: 报道：黑客用 AI 代理攻击逾百网站，受害者包括多家企业
entries.summary_zh: The Verge 援引安全公司 Norforge 称，一名攻击者通过开源 AI 平台 Cairn 编排代理，入侵了 100 多个网站，代理承担了大部分操作；The Verge 另援引 Reuters 指出 John Deere、SharkNinja、Cummins 等公司可能在受害者之列。报道基于 Norforge 的发现与媒体转述，未在所给材料中列出完整受害清单或独立取证细节，说明的是代理可能扩大攻击自动化，而非证明代理能脱离人类独立策划入侵。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合安全团队关注代理自动化对攻击规模和防御监测的影响，同时留意事件证据来源。
entries.pragmatic_review: 应把自动化代理的高频探测纳入网站日志与速率限制设计。
entries.cynic_review: 受害者信息经多层转述，完整攻击链和归因仍需核实。
entries.paper_review: 目前是安全公司调查与新闻报道，未见完整技术报告或独立复现。

entries.source_title: GR-OPD: Group-Relative Sequence Credit for On-Policy Distillation
entries.source_excerpt: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides token-level teacher feedback, yet common sampled-token updates assign credit locally and omit the effects of earlier actions on subsequent feedback. We introduce \method{} (Group-Relative On-Policy Distillation), which decouples feedback computation from credit assignment by aggregating token feedback into calibrated sequence-level credit. We establish a theoretical basis for this approach by showing that, under ideal on-policy assumptions, broadcasting raw summed feedback to every response token yields an unbiased estimate of the negative gradient of the sequence-level reverse-KL objective. To support effective learning in practice, \method{} discounts later feedback that may become less reliable under distribution shift and uses same-prompt rollout groups to calibrate teacher guidance. It preserves relative response preferences while retaining a controlled fraction of the group mean, which we term collective teacher pressure. Across five Qwen3 teacher--student settings and six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, \method{} outperforms vanilla OPD in macro Avg@K in every setting, including gains of
entries.title_zh: GR-OPD：面向 on-policy 蒸馏的组相对序列信用分配
entries.summary_zh: 论文提出 GR-OPD，将教师逐 token 反馈汇总为经校准的序列级信用，以处理早期动作影响后续反馈的问题。理想 on-policy 条件下，向所有响应 token 广播原始总反馈可无偏估计序列 reverse-KL 目标的负梯度；方法还对后段不可靠反馈折扣，并用同 prompt rollout 组校准教师指导，在 Qwen3 的五种师生配置和六个数学推理基准上优于 vanilla OPD。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合关注语言模型蒸馏和数学推理训练信用分配的读者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 提供梯度解释，并在多个数学基准报告超过基线。
entries.cynic_review: 理想假设与实际分布偏移间差距、具体提升幅度需审阅实验。
entries.paper_review: 方法和理论依据明确，稳健性及与强基线比较需阅读全文。

entries.source_title: Sharp asymptotics for the Lov\'asz number of random circulant graphs
entries.source_excerpt: We study the LOV\'ASZ number of dense random circulant graphs generated by independent Bernoulli bits indexed by cyclic distances. Although only $O(n)$ independent random inputs determine $O(n^2)$ globally dependent edge indicators, we prove sharp expectation asymptotics along all odd orders, including composite orders, with leading constant one. This resolves a conjecture posed for random circulant graphs in 2025. The proof combines an exact Fourier reduction and complementary duality with a positive interior smoothing that reveals a nonlinear random fixed-point equation. To analyze this equation under the strong dependence of the distance-bit model, we construct canonical tree fields, establish growing-degree Gaussian approximations through polynomial comparison and Wick/Hermite expansions, and transfer the resulting approximation back to the original sign model. A deterministic residual estimate together with an explicit exceptional-event integration yields the sharp expectation asymptotics.
entries.title_zh: 随机循环图 Lovász 数的尖锐渐近
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究由循环距离上的 Bernoulli 随机变量生成的稠密随机循环图。结果证明所有奇数阶（包括合数阶）的 Lovász 数期望具有首项常数 1 的尖锐渐近，解决 2025 年提出的猜想；证明结合 Fourier 化简、对偶性及处理强依赖性的高斯近似。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 概率与图论读者可关注随机图依赖结构下半定规划参数的精确渐近。
entries.pragmatic_review: 解决猜想且覆盖所有奇数阶，结论明确。
entries.cynic_review: 强依赖模型的近似和残差控制技术门槛较高。
entries.paper_review: 摘要给出尖锐渐近及证明主线，常数归一化和误差项需核对全文。

entries.source_title: nvidia/Nemotron-Personas-Vietnam
entries.source_excerpt: Nemotron-Personas-Vietnam Hệ thống AI kết hợp để tạo personas tổng hợp dựa trên phân bố thực tế của Việt Nam A compound AI approach to personas grounded in real-world distributions Tổng quan (Overview) Nemotron-Personas-Vietnam là tập dữ liệu personas được cung cấp dưới dạng mã nguồn mở (CC BY 4.0) dựa trên phân bố nhân khẩu học, địa lý và đặc điểm tính cách của người Việt Nam. Tập dữ liệu phản ánh một cách toàn diện sự phong phú và đặc trưng… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/Nemotron-Personas-Vietnam.
entries.title_zh: NVIDIA 越南人物画像合成数据集 Nemotron-Personas-Vietnam
entries.summary_zh: 这是一个以越南人口统计、地理和文化背景分布为依据合成的人物画像数据集，包含年龄、性别、婚姻状况、教育程度、职业和地区等字段；页面称数据参考越南统计总局等资料，并覆盖2025年合并后的34个省级行政区和54个民族。数据集有100万条记录，以标准越南语生成，采用 NeMo Data Designer、专有概率图模型和 SaoLa-Small-32B 制作；其用途是为越南语模型训练扩充合成数据并提高回复多样性，页面所述效果属于设计目标，材料未给出验证结果。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 可供研究者评估合成人物画像如何编码人口分布与文化背景，也适合测试越南语模型在不同年龄、职业和地区设定下的回复差异；其规模和字段明确，便于设计分组分析。
entries.pragmatic_review: 若在做越南语对话或合成数据研究，可先检查字段与样本分布，再抽样评估是否适合目标任务。
entries.cynic_review: 页面称其旨在缓解偏差并反映真实分布，但条目本身是人工生成的，材料没有提供代表性或偏差改善的量化证据。
entries.paper_review: 材料列出统计资料来源、生成工具和数据规模，但没有提供论文、完整生成流程或独立评测结果供核查。

project_insight.translation_zh: Nemotron-Personas-Vietnam 是一个依据越南真实人口统计、地理和个性特征分布合成的人物画像数据集，采用 CC BY 4.0 许可。它包含性别、年龄、婚姻状况、教育程度、职业和居住地区等属性；数据参考越南统计总局资料，并由 NVIDIA 与 FPT Smart Cloud、FPT 旗下量子人工智能与网络安全研究所共同开发。该数据集使用 NeMo Data Designer、专有概率图模型和 SaoLa-Small-32B 生成，面向越南语模型训练，目标是扩充合成数据多样性、减少数据与模型偏差并提高回复多样性。页面说明数据完全由合成方法生成，使用标准越南语，不包含姓名字段，也不覆盖金融、医疗等企业专用画像。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 提供100万条越南语合成人物画像样本，可用于构造带有人口统计、职业、地区与文化背景条件的模型训练或评测数据。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先阅读数据集卡片并查看字段说明，从 Hugging Face 页面抽取少量样本检查语言、字段完整性和画像合理性；再按目标任务定义抽样与分布核验方案，并在训练或评测前确认 CC BY 4.0 的署名要求。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 这是合成数据，不是真实个体样本；页面称其旨在贴近现实分布，但未在所给材料中展示代表性、偏差缓解或下游效果的评测证据。它使用标准越南语，缺少姓名字段和金融、医疗等企业专用画像；生成过程还依赖专有概率图模型。页面标注 CC BY 4.0。
use_cases_zh: 比较越南语模型对不同年龄、教育程度、职业和地区画像的回复差异。
为越南语对话系统构造合成用户画像，开展覆盖性和鲁棒性测试。
分析合成人物画像数据的字段分布，并与公开统计资料进行一致性检查。

entries.source_title: Unified Multiparadigm Fusion Intelligence for Rare Disease Diagnosis
entries.source_excerpt: Rare diseases (RDs) affect an estimated 300 million people globally, leaving patients to navigate a protracted diagnostic odyssey constrained by clinical scarcity and fragmented medical knowledge. Artificial intelligence (AI) has progressively advanced RD diagnostics, from symbolic methods and deep learning to large language model (LLM)-based systems. However, each paradigm carries structural limitations: symbolic methods are bounded by knowledge completeness, neural models sacrifice interpretability, and LLM-based systems are vulnerable to evaluation biases like data leakage. In this study, we introduce FusionRare, a unified multiparadigm fusion framework integrating knowledge-driven symbolic reasoning, deep-learning pattern recognition, case-based patient retrieval, and LLM-based heuristic inference via statistical meta-aggregation and knowledge-enhanced agentic reflection. Evaluated on 2,528 strictly isolated clinical cases, FusionRare achieves state-of-the-art RD prioritization, attaining a macro-averaged Recall @1 of 51% for phenotype-only diagnosis and 79% for phenotype-genotype joint analysis. entries.title_zh: 罕见病诊断的多范式融合智能系统
entries.summary_zh: 作者提出 FusionRare，将知识驱动符号推理、深度学习模式识别、病例检索和 LLM 启发式推断结合，并用统计元聚合及知识增强反思融合结果。在 2528 个严格隔离病例上，报告表型单独诊断 Recall@1 为 51%，表型加基因型为 79%；这些是作者基准结果，临床部署价值仍需前瞻性验证。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合关注罕见病候选诊断排序、多源医学知识与 AI 评测的读者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 将多种方法的优点组合，并报告病例规模与两种输入设置成绩。
entries.cynic_review: 基准隔离不等于真实临床验证，Recall@1 也不能替代诊断安全评估。
entries.paper_review: 量化指标明确，但摘要未说明外部验证和临床流程。

entries.source_title: Spectral networks, finite webs, and the $T_3$ cubic differential
entries.source_excerpt: Authors: Omar Kidwai , Guillaume Tahar; Subjects: Algebraic Geometry (math.AG) ; High Energy Physics - Theory (hep-th); Mathematical Physics (math-ph); Differential Geometry (math.DG); This listing provides paper metadata; open the original for the abstract.
entries.title_zh: 谱网络、有限 webs 与 T₃ 三次微分
entries.summary_zh: 采集只提供题名、作者及数学物理等领域标签。题名将谱网络、有限 web 与 T₃ 理论中的三次微分联系起来；文章的分类结果、几何构造及物理解释均未见于所给摘录，需读原文确认。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合数学物理、微分几何及谱网络研究者追踪 T₃ 相关结构。
entries.pragmatic_review: 题名指出几个有明确研究背景的结构对象之间的联系。
entries.cynic_review: 没有摘要，无法判断是构造、分类还是计算工作。
entries.paper_review: 证据不足以评价定理或物理含义。

entries.source_title: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce
entries.title_zh: Disney 将聘用 Character.AI 多数员工
entries.summary_zh: TechCrunch 根据破产程序文件报道，Disney 同意向至少 60 名 Character.AI 员工发出聘用邀约，年薪总额估计约 6000 万美元，多数受邀员工已接受；这属于资产交易安排的一部分。Character.AI 此前称 Disney 将以 2000 万美元收购部分资产，但该交易是“备选竞价”方案，仍可能出现更高报价；文件还提到高成本和潜在诉讼责任是公司困境因素。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合观察角色聊天产品的商业成本、法律风险，以及人才和知识产权如何在破产交易中拆分。
entries.pragmatic_review: 这笔安排显示企业可能更看重团队与技术资产的组合价值。
entries.cynic_review: 聘用邀约和资产收购仍受破产竞价程序影响，结果未必最终确定。
entries.paper_review: 报道引用法律文件细节，但当前摘录未提供完整合同条款。

entries.source_title: 亚马逊利用人工智能监测英国仓库的工会风险
entries.title_zh: 亚马逊使用 AI 监测英国仓库的工会风险
entries.summary_zh: openDemocracy 根据诉讼披露的内部文件报道，亚马逊的 Atlas 工具会汇集数百项数据，为仓库的工会活动风险打分，并将评分用于风险管理和资源规划。报道引述工会及法律组织的批评，也转述亚马逊称该工具评估的是站点层面的活动，不追踪个人观点、工会关系或个人数据；现有材料呈现了双方说法和文件内容，但并未独立验证工具的实际运行方式。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 关注职场监控、算法管理和工会组织权利的读者，可从这篇报道了解 Atlas 的评分逻辑、据称使用的数据类型及相关争议。
entries.pragmatic_review: 文章具体列出评分区间、风险等级和可能影响的管理决策，便于理解此类预测工具如何进入劳动管理。
entries.cynic_review: 报道依据内部文件提出监控风险，同时也刊载亚马逊的反驳，文件适用范围和工具实际使用情况仍需结合完整证据判断。
entries.paper_review: 材料转述了内部文件、诉讼背景和多方表态，但没有提供完整文件集、模型代码或独立审计结果。

entries.source_title: armadillo-lib/armadillo-code
entries.source_excerpt: Armadillo: fast C++ library for linear algebra (matrix maths) & scientific computing - https://arma.sourceforge.net
entries.title_zh: Armadillo：C++ 线性代数与科学计算库
entries.summary_zh: Armadillo 是面向线性代数和科学计算的 C++ 库，提供向量、矩阵、立方体及 200 多个相关函数，接口风格有意接近 Matlab。特征值、SVD、QR 等分解通过 LAPACK 或兼容实现提供；项目称其目标是在速度和易用性之间取得平衡。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合用 C++ 实现数值算法或将研究代码转入生产环境的人；README 说明了 BLAS、LAPACK 等依赖、稀疏矩阵组件和 Windows 编译选项，便于判断接入成本。
entries.pragmatic_review: 如果你的项目使用 C++，可从官方函数文档和一个小型矩阵运算原型开始，并按需求配置 BLAS、LAPACK 及稀疏矩阵依赖。
entries.cynic_review: “高质量”和“高效”是项目自述，实际速度与功能取决于编译器、BLAS/LAPACK 实现及使用场景；README 还列有 LLM 使用限制，使用前应查阅具体条款。
entries.paper_review: 摘录提供了依赖、版本策略和两篇引用论文的信息，但未包含论文全文、基准数据或本次评测证据。

project_insight.translation_zh: Armadillo 是一个 C++ 线性代数与科学计算库，旨在兼顾速度和易用性。它提供向量、矩阵和立方体类，以及 200 多个矩阵处理函数；特征值、SVD、QR 等分解通过 LAPACK 或高性能替代库实现，并以模板元编程表达式求值器合并部分运算以提高速度和效率。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: Armadillo 为 C++ 提供接近 Matlab 风格的矩阵运算接口，并借助 BLAS/LAPACK 实现常见数值线性代数操作。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先查阅官方函数文档、安装说明和 API 稳定性策略；确认编译器支持 C++14，并按是否需要稀疏矩阵决定是否配置 ARPACK、SuperLU。用小型程序核对链接库与目标平台后，再纳入正式项目。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 需要支持 C++14 的编译器；部分功能依赖 BLAS、LAPACK、ARPACK 或 SuperLU，实际构建配置因平台而异。摘录列出了 Apache 2.0 许可及 NOTICE 归属要求，也列有“禁止使用大型语言模型（LLMs）”一节，但没有提供该节的具体条款，应先核对原文再决定相关使用方式。
use_cases_zh: 在 C++ 项目中实现矩阵运算、特征值或 QR/SVD 等数值算法。
将 Matlab 风格的研究原型迁移到 C++ 应用中。
为统计、信号处理或计算机视觉程序配置稠密或稀疏线性代数功能。

entries.source_title: stablyai/orca
entries.source_excerpt: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
entries.title_zh: Orca：并行编排编程智能体的工作台
entries.summary_zh: Orca 将 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode、Pi 等终端编程智能体集中在桌面工作区中，并提供独立 Git worktree、终端分屏、移动端监控、远程 SSH worktree 和差异审阅等功能。项目介绍还列出 CLI 自动化、GitHub 与 Linear 集成及可视化设计模式；这些能力和“适用于任意 CLI 智能体”等说法来自仓库自述。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合同时使用多个编程智能体、需要比较并行实现或在手机上跟进长任务的个人开发者；独立 worktree 和差异批注也为审阅 AI 生成的代码提供了具体工作流。
entries.pragmatic_review: 功能覆盖从并行执行到结果审阅的开发流程，个人用户可先挑一个日常仓库验证 worktree、终端和所用智能体的兼容性。
entries.cynic_review: 仓库自述功能丰富且更新频繁，但“任意 CLI 智能体可用”等兼容性承诺、隐私遥测细节和移动端配对体验在摘录中没有独立证据。

entries.source_title: Sums of two dependent uniform random variables: a characterization by joint tail bounds
entries.source_excerpt: Which laws can the sum of two uniform random variables have when nothing is known about how they depend on each other? For three or more uniform summands, convex order gives the answer; for two it does not, and the question has been open. We show that the attainable laws are exactly those that satisfy a family of explicit joint bounds on sums of tail probabilities, one bound for each finite set of thresholds. For laws with a density at most one, convex order alone decides. For densities at most two, convex order implies the simplest of the joint bounds, and the constant two cannot be raised for single-threshold bounds. The number of thresholds a law needs is set by the spacing of its atoms, not by how many atoms it has.

entries.source_title: Geometric multigrid preconditioners for unfitted discretisations of the de Rham complex
entries.source_excerpt: We propose two families of multigrid preconditioners for unfitted finite element discretisations of the Riesz maps of the de Rham complex, in H(grad), H(curl) and H(div), stabilised by cell aggregation. The first is a geometric multigrid method applied directly to the unfitted operators, on a hierarchy of background meshes that share the same boundary representation. Its smoothers are star patches built on the aggregated mesh, so that each patch captures the kernel of the stabilisation. The second is a multilevel auxiliary-space preconditioner that combines a patch smoother localised around the cut cells with the body-fitted problem on the active mesh, which is in turn solved by a non-nested geometric multigrid method. Both are used as building blocks of block-diagonal preconditioners for the mixed Hodge Laplacians. entries.source_title: A note on the rectangular Schoenberg-Whitney theorem for clamped B-splines
entries.source_excerpt: Wang et al.(Computer-Aided Design 40 (2008) 999-1008) proposed a knot-subsequence characterization of full row rank for rectangular B-spline collocation matrices. We identify an incorrect inequality in their Appendix proof, which invalidates the argument as written, and make explicit the endpoint and multiplicity conventions on which the criterion depends. The defect lies in the proof, not in the underlying result, which is valid under suitably stated hypotheses; in the lofting construction of Wang et al. these hypotheses are implicitly satisfied, so the lofted curves are unaffected. We state the corrected result and give a new proof, independent of the disputed argument, for clamped B-splines of arbitrary degree with continuous interior multiplicities. In our proof, sufficiency follows from inclusion of spline spaces and knot insertion; necessity selects independent columns and builds the reduced knot vector from them. The proof uses no recursive column-selection construction.

entries.source_title: Gaps for PLRS with zero coefficients
entries.source_excerpt: Zeckendorf proved that every positive integer has a unique decomposition as a sum of non-adjacent Fibonacci numbers. Among its extensions, we focus on Positive Linear Recurrence Sequences (PLRS): fixed depth recurrences with non-negative integral coefficients whose first and last terms are positive: $G_{n+1} = c_1 G_n + \dots + c_L G_{n-L+1}$ with $c_i$ non-negative integers and $c_1 c_L \ge 1$. We again find every integer can be written uniquely as an appropriate sum of terms of the sequence, and we can study the distribution of gaps between summands in decompositions. Bower et al. (2015) proved that if each $c_i \ge 1$ then the distribution of gaps in the generalized Zeckendorf decompositions of integers in $[G_n, G_{n+1})$ converges to a geometric decay for gaps at least two. What if some of the $c_i$'s are allowed to be zero? To date only the Kangaroo case, where there is a fixed $g$ such that $c_i = 1$ if $i \equiv 1 \bmod g$ and 0 otherwise, has been done and again geometric behavior emerges. entries.source_title: The square achievement game on $n \times n$ boards
entries.source_excerpt: Two players alternately claim cells of an $n \times n$ grid; the first to hold all four corners of an axis-parallel square wins, and a full board without one is a draw. The first player has a winning strategy if and only if $n \ge 5$, which answers a question of Erickson. For $n \ge 6$ one strategy serves every board: a rule with no lookup table whose moves after the second reply are all forcing, built around the plus, a stone with the four cells at a common distance from it along the axes, a shape proposed for this game by Sirgedas in 2010. The rule is checked on the boards of size $6$ to $17$, and a simulation theorem carries one checked run on the $23 \times 23$ board to every larger board. The proofs are formalized in Lean 4, and the theorem for the rule states that the tree of its own moves is winning.

entries.source_title: Probabilistic large deviations approach to obstacle Hamilton-Jacobi equations
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we derive a non-classical variational representation of a viscosity solution of a Hamilton-Jacobi equation with obstacle, in which the Hamiltonian may take infinite values. We study a nonlinear selection-mutation model with an exponential-decay mutation kernel, using a probabilistic Feynman-Kac representation of a pure jump process. To handle the singular character of this process, we rely on a non-standard tool from large deviations theory, which allows us to establish a Varadhan-type lemma. This, in turn, yields the variational representation of the viscosity solution.

entries.source_title: What RL Brings to Reasoning: A Few Decisions the Base Model Would Not Make
entries.source_excerpt: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) substantially improves mathematical reasoning, but what it adds to the base model remains unclear. We investigate this through a sequence of generation-time interventions on Qwen3-4B-Base, measuring how much of its RL-trained counterpart's gain each intervention recovers on 120 AIME problems. Power sampling with the same 8,192-token output limit brings no gain beyond greedy decoding. Yet borrowing the RL model's token only where the two models' greedy choices differ, roughly 4% of generated positions, recovers 90.5% of the pass@1 gain, with similar recovery across three model pairs on MATH-500. We find that even a single opening token has a substantial effect: forcing the base model to begin with "Alright" recovers 35% of the RL gain. The opening alone is insufficient, however. Later replacements after the same opening add another 5.2 percentage points to pass@1, and the fixed rules we test for inserting reflective words such as "Wait" do not reproduce this benefit. entries.source_title: A Gauge-Invariant Finite Element Method for the Time-Dependent Ginzburg--Landau Equations
entries.source_excerpt: It is well known that the Ginzburg--Landau equations are gauge invariant. The most popular gauge choice in practical simulations is the temporal gauge, also known as the zero electric potential gauge. However, the commonly used N\'ed\'elec approximations may produce spurious giant vortices on domains with re-entrant corners. To address this issue while retaining the N\'ed\'elec approximation, we propose a finite element scheme that preserves the gauge invariance of the time-dependent Ginzburg--Landau equations at the discrete level. Under the temporal gauge, the method employs lowest-order N\'ed\'elec edge elements for the magnetic potential and continuous piecewise-linear elements for the order parameter on triangular and tetrahedral meshes, and yields a linear, decoupled formulation that requires only the solution of linear systems at each time step. We prove that the scheme is gauge invariant, preserves a discrete maximum bound principle for the order parameter, $\|\psi_h^n\|_{L^\infty(\Omega)}\le 1$, and satisfies a discrete energy law under mild step-size and mesh conditions. entries.source_title: Uniform convergence at optimal rate and scale
entries.source_excerpt: Uniform convergence asks how many random samples suffice for empirical averages to approximate expectations simultaneously over an entire class of functions. It is a central concept in probability and a foundation of statistical learning. For binary-valued classes, the Vapnik--Chervonenkis theorem characterizes uniform convergence by finiteness of the VC dimension. For dimension $d$, the sharp worst-case sample complexity for additive error $\varepsilon$ is of order $d/\varepsilon^2$. For real-valued functions, the analogous combinatorial parameter is the fat-shattering dimension, which depends on an approximation scale $\gamma$. The challenge is to achieve error $\gamma+\varepsilon$ with order $d/\varepsilon^2$ samples, matching the sample bound for binary classes, where $d$ is now the fat-shattering dimension at scale $\gamma$. Previous results achieved either the optimal scale or the optimal sample complexity, but not both. Our main result closes this gap, establishing the sharp sample complexity at the optimal scale. entries.source_title: Dihedral fields with Bloch lattice index five and quadratic subfield Q(i)
entries.source_excerpt: We construct infinitely many Galois extensions $M/\mathbb{Q}$ with dihedral group of order ten, quadratic subfield $\mathbb{Q}(i)$, and Bloch lattice index $Q_2(M)=5$. More precisely, we specify a Chebotarev set of rational primes of density $1/50$. For every prime $\ell$ in this set, at least two of four mixed cyclic quintic extensions of $\mathbb{Q}(i)$ of conductor $(25\ell)$ have this index and satisfy $K_2(O_M)(5)\simeq(\mathbb{Z}/5)^2$. A two-dimensional cup-product pencil selects the extensions. Generalized Bockstein maps, integral co-descent, and a motivic genus formula then determine the tame kernel and the subfield Bloch-lattice index. The result is unconditional.

entries.source_title: Training with Ciphers to Enhance In-Context Terminology Learning For Translation from Rare Languages
entries.source_excerpt: Fine-tuning LLMs with in-context examples (IC-Train) lets translation models adapt to new parallel data at deployment, but it is unclear whether they actually learn the translations of rare terms from those examples. We formalize this capability as in-context term learning (ICTL). We show that standard IC-Train develops this capability only weakly, and propose RareCipherFT, which strengthens it without any lexical resources. RareCipherFT pairs each training target with in-context examples that share a rare term with it. It then replaces that term with a character-shuffled cipher in both the context and the reference, so the term can only be recovered by copying from context. The ciphered fraction of training data is annealed to preserve translation quality. Across seven translation directions between English and Tamil, Assamese, Mizo, Nepali and Hausa, and four models from 1B to 7B parameters, RareCipherFT raises term recall over standard IC-Train by 5-15 absolute points without lowering COMET. Probes using synonyms, nonce words and controls for shared surface context show that these gains come from linking source terms to their in-co
entries.title_zh: 通过密码训练增强稀有语言翻译的上下文术语学习

entries.source_title: Pearl-Chat: Engineering a native Luganda language model from first principles in JAX and Flax NNX
entries.source_excerpt: Autoregressive foundation language models predominantly target high-resource Indo-European languages, imposing computational and morphological penalties on under-represented African languages. Generic multilingual tokenizers routinely exceed fertility rates of 3.2 tokens per word on agglutinative Bantu languages, degrading context efficiency and inflating latency. We present Pearl-Chat, an 8,473,122-parameter ($\sim$8.5M) causal decoder-only transformer engineered for Luganda (Oluganda, ISO 639-2: lg), a low-resource Niger-Congo Bantu language spoken by over 10 million people in East Africa. Built from first mathematical principles in JAX and Flax NNX, Pearl-Chat uses explicit functional state decomposition (nnx.split and nnx.merge), deterministic resumable data streaming via Google Grain, and SPMD tensor parallelism using jax.sharding.Mesh. We introduce a byte-level byte-pair encoding (BPE) subword tokenizer trained from scratch on curated Luganda corpora ($V = 8,192$), achieving 4.88 characters per token compression and 1.60 tokens per word fertility, a two-fold compression improvement over LLaMA-3 (128K) and Gemma (256K). The model

entries.source_title: Quadratic mixing for the Lee--Sidford Dikin walk
entries.source_excerpt: Let $K=\{x\in\R^d:Ax\ge b\}$ be a bounded full-dimensional polytope with $m$ inequalities. For targets on $K$ with density proportional to $\exp(-\vartheta^\transpose x)$, we prove a $\widetilde O(d^2)$ bound, measured in Markov chain iterations, for the chi-square mixing of the $1/2$-lazy Metropolis Dikin walk based on a polylogarithmically rescaled Lee--Sidford metric. The estimate holds for every initial law with finite chi-square divergence. The proof controls the reverse Gaussian proposal through a quantitative average self-concordance estimate at the required $O(1/d)$ scale. We establish this estimate from uniform analytic derivative bounds for the Lewis-weight subspace and an all-order projection-weighted contraction inequality for Gaussian chaoses. For order $j$, the latter bounds each base-point polynomial at scale $d^{j/2}$, up to $j$-dependent and logarithmic factors. Truncating at logarithmic order then absorbs the remaining pathwise loss. entries.title_zh: Lee–Sidford Dikin 随机游走的二次混合时间界
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究有界满维多面体上的 Lee–Sidford 度量 Dikin 随机游走，证明半惰性 Metropolis 链对目标密度 exp(−θᵀx) 的卡方混合时间为 Õ(d²) 次迭代，适用于任意具有有限初始卡方散度的分布。核心技术是以定量平均自协调性控制反向高斯提议，并结合 Lewis 权重导数界与高斯混沌的全阶投影收缩不等式；作者称这解决了此前 rigorously established 最好为 Õ(d^(9/4)) 的开放问题，摘要同时注明证明由 ChatGPT 5.6 Pro 找到，数学结论仍应按论文证明审查。

entries.source_title: The Schubert bialgebra
entries.source_excerpt: We introduce a Schubert bialgebra $\mathcal{A}=\bigoplus_{n\geq 0}\mathbb{Z}[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$, in which polynomials in different numbers of variables multiply to zero and the coproduct splits the variables into two consecutive blocks, and study its graded dual $\mathcal{D}$, whose product is concatenation of weak compositions. The Schubert polynomials $\mathfrak{S}_u^n$ form a basis of $\mathcal{A}$; we give an explicit formula for the dual Schubert basis $\Xi_u^n$ of $\mathcal{D}$ via a transition formula to an elementary symmetric basis, and show that the Schubert structure constants $c_{u,v}^w$ are the coefficients of the coproduct of $\mathcal{D}$ in the dual Schubert basis. The product of $\mathcal{D}$ is then lifted to an associative product $\sqcup$ on the free abelian group $\mathcal{BRC}$ of bounded RC graphs, built from a transition map $\mathcal{Z}$ on RC graphs that realizes the Lascoux-Sch\"utzenberger transition formula and generalizes Little's bumping algorithm. Quotienting $\mathcal{BRC}$ by ideals coming from Demazure crystal equivalence, Nadeau-Tewari forest equivalence, and quasi-Yamanouchi equivalence yields manife

entries.source_title: Certified neural approximations for parabolic obstacle problems
entries.source_excerpt: Residual-trained neural surrogates carry no error guarantee, a limitation for free-boundary problems such as phase change and contact. We derive guaranteed error bounds for neural approximations of parabolic obstacle problems in first-order state--flux--multiplier form. The main result bounds the flux error of the network and the energy error of its feasible projection $\max\{v,g\}$ by the constitutive residual, the initial mismatch, the complementarity defect, and the PDE residual weighted by $c_F^2/\alpha$, without the coercivity and norm-equivalence constants of the first-order formulation. It extends the Apushkinskaya--Repin majorant for the heat operator to general coefficients, free multipliers and a flux bound. A penetration-consistency result shows that neural triples with arbitrarily small bound exist. Outward-rounded cellwise Taylor-model enclosures turn the bound into a finite computation valid on any adaptive partition. entries.source_title: Low-weight compactly supported cohomology of $\mathcal M_{g,n}^{ct}$ and the extended Torelli morphism
entries.source_excerpt: We study the weight zero and weight two graded pieces of the compactly supported cohomology of the moduli space $\mathcal M_{g,n}^{ct}$ of stable $n$-pointed curves of genus $g$ of compact type and show that they are computed by bridgeless graph complexes. In weight two, we construct a natural embedding of shifted weight zero cohomology from lower genus. For unmarked curves, we construct canonical classes represented by pinched odd wheel graphs and prove that distinct wheel monomials give linearly independent classes in the dual of $W_0H_c^{2g}(\mathcal M_g^{ct};\mathbb Q)$. By relating the bridgeless graph complex to the $K$-theory of graphs and the Quillen spectral sequence, we show that these classes remain linearly independent after pushforward along the extended Torelli morphism $\mathcal M_g^{ct}\to\mathcal A_g$. Finally, we prove that the realizations of the motivic Lie algebra arising from $\mathcal M_g$ and $\mathcal A_g$ have the same image in the weight zero compactly supported cohomology of $\mathcal M_g^{ct}$.
entries.title_zh: 紧致型曲线模空间的低权紧支撑上同调与扩展 Torelli 映射
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究紧致型稳定曲线模空间 M_{g,n}^{ct} 的权零与权二紧支撑上同调，并用无桥图复形计算这些部分。对无标记曲线，作者构造由压扁奇数轮图表示的典范类，证明不同轮图单项式在权零上同调的对偶中线性独立，且通过图 K 理论与 Quillen 谱序列证明这些类经扩展 Torelli 映射推前到阿贝尔簇模空间后仍独立；最后比较两种 motivic Lie 代数实现的像。

entries.source_title: Rapid convergence of Langevin AIS for multimodal distributions on $\mathbb{R}^d$
entries.source_excerpt: We study annealed importance sampling (AIS) driven by the overdamped Langevin diffusion, targeting a multimodal Gibbs measure $\pi_\varepsilon \propto e^{-U/\varepsilon}$ on $\mathbb{R}^d$ at low temperature $\varepsilon$. For a potential $U$ with nondegenerate critical points, finitely many wells of comparable mass, and at least quadratic growth at infinity, we show that AIS with a harmonically spaced temperature schedule produces a weighted empirical measure that approximates $\pi_\varepsilon$ to accuracy $\delta$ at a total cost of order $\varepsilon^{-2}\delta^{-2}$, up to logarithmic factors, and the exponents do not depend on the dimension. This is an exponential improvement over plain Langevin Monte Carlo, whose relaxation time obeys the Arrhenius law. The assumptions cover, in particular, the potentials of Gaussian mixtures, as long as their critical points are nondegenerate and their wells carry comparable mass. The analysis extends that of arXiv:2604.17526 [math.PR] from the torus $\mathbb{T}^d$ to the noncompact state space $\mathbb{R}^d$. entries.source_title: Planar Disk Filters and Real Chromatic Roots at Beraha Numbers
entries.source_excerpt: We construct simple plane triangulations whose chromatic polynomials have real roots accumulating at every noninteger Beraha number $B_\ell=4\cos^2(\pi/\ell)$; the integer values $0,1,2,3$ are roots of $K_4$. The construction rests on the observation that a triangulated disk with four boundary vertices acts, inside a larger triangulation, as a transfer operator lying in a commutative three-parameter algebra. Rotating such disks by a quarter turn and composing them in series moves their eigenvalue triples around this algebra in a controllable way, and for every fixed $q\in(B_{10},4)$ one can manufacture a finite disk whose two competing local eigenvalues are strictly dominated by the third -- a physical filter. entries.title_zh: 平面圆盘滤波器与 Beraha 数处的实色多项式根

entries.source_title: Ramanujan Conjecture and Riemann Hypothesis for the unitary groups over function fields
entries.source_excerpt: We establish generic local and global Langlands functoriality, namely stable base change, for the unitary groups in characteristic $p$. Main applications are the Ramanujan Conjecture and the Riemann Hypothesis for extended Langlands-Shahidi $L$-functions of the unitary groups over function fields.

entries.source_title: Models of Arbitrary Sets
entries.source_excerpt: There is a growing literature on arbitrary objects as other types of mathematical objects, besides particular mathematical objects. In this paper we study arbitrary sets in the context of ZFC set theory. An arbitrary object is one that is determined by a state space across which it varies and by its instantiations. We compare two semantic strategies. First, we analyse the possibility of modeling arbitrary sets using direct powers of a ZFC structure. This yields a natural setting, but one where Extensionality and, crucially, the full Separation scheme fail. Second, we consider structures composed of arbitrary sets using a direct power construction evaluated in a Boolean-valued semantics. Within this setting, we develop the cumulative hierarchy of arbitrary sets, arbitrary ordinals, cardinals, and filtrations of the structure of arbitrary sets. The final section develops a combinatorial interpretation in terms of independent assignments across a fixed state space. Its connection with the iterative conception is then discussed.
entries.title_zh: 任意集合的模型

entries.source_title: On the Ramanujan-Ligozat modular unit
entries.source_excerpt: Let $\chi$ be the quadratic Dirichlet character of conductor $N$ associated with a given real quadratic field $k$ and let $X_\chi(N)$ be the double covering of $X_0(N)$ associated with $\chi$. In this note, we study a modular unit $f$ on the curve $X_\chi(N)$. We prove that the transform of $f$ by the Fricke involution $\mathscr{w}_N$ is the level $N$ analogue of the Rogers-Ramanujan continued fraction introduced by Lee and Park. Furthermore, if $N$ is a positive prime discriminant, then $f$ is Ligozat's modular unit, which is known from Mazur's work on the Eisenstein ideal. We extend Ligozat's construction to any positive fundamental discriminant $N$.
entries.title_zh: Ramanujan–Ligozat 模单位
entries.summary_zh: 作者研究与实二次域相关的曲线 Xχ(N) 上的模单位 f，证明其经 Fricke 对合变换后是 Lee 与 Park 提出的 Rogers–Ramanujan 连分数的 N 级推广。若 N 为正素判别式，f 恰为 Mazur Eisenstein 理论中已知的 Ligozat 模单位，并把 Ligozat 构造推广到任意正基本判别式 N。

entries.source_title: The Navier-Stokes Announcement: A case study in mathematical values
entries.source_excerpt: On September 8, 2026, OpenAI announced a resolution of the Navier-Stokes problem. I had expected to feel excitement if a solution was announced. Instead, my reaction was one of grief and revulsion. I will use the announcement to explore the universal human desires that underlie my reaction, I hope in a fashion that will reach beyond mathematicians.

entries.source_title: Metric Poissonian Pair Correlation Property Part 2: The Case \(n\log n\)
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that $(\alpha n\log n)_{n\ge1}$ has Poissonian pair correlation for almost every real $\alpha$, solving a Problem posed by Aistleitner, El-Baz and Munsch [Open Problem 3, Geom. Funct. Anal. 2021]. Our main contribution is a new four-point counting estimate with a fixed power saving over $N^{7/3}$ at tolerance $N^{-1}$, valid on the ranges left after a first-moment and Borel--Cantelli argument. Its proof reduces the counting condition to the required proximity of an implicitly defined real root to an integer; a Fej\'er kernel majorizes this condition, and multidimensional van der Corput $A$- and $B$-processes supply the saving. A localized Mellin argument then yields the second-moment estimate needed for the metric conclusion.
entries.title_zh: 度量 Poisson 配对相关性（二）：αn log n 序列
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明，对几乎所有实数 α，序列 (α n log n) 的 Poissonian pair correlation 成立，从而解决 Aistleitner、El-Baz 与 Munsch 2021 年提出的开放问题。证明关键是建立四点计数估计，在 N^(7/3) 上取得固定幂次节省，再用 Fejér 核、多维 van der Corput A/B 过程和局部 Mellin 方法得到所需二阶矩估计。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合研究均匀分布与数论序列局部统计的读者，展示四点计数如何导出几乎处处的配对相关结论。

entries.source_title: From Stories to Features: Scaling Concept Vectors for AI Alignment & Interpretability
entries.source_excerpt: We study feature vectors: directions in a language model's activation space that correspond to human-interpretable concepts, such as honesty or deception. Existing unsupervised methods like sparse autoencoders attempt to recover the whole feature space, often at the cost of feature quality and interpretability. We take a more pragmatic route: focusing on concepts relevant to AI safety and alignment, we generate synthetic concept-antagonist story pairs and use the difference of their mean model activations as a feature vector. We scale this approach to 1,036 alignment-relevant concepts using 2M synthetic stories across multiple languages and genres, which we publicly release. Across six models from three model families, our feature vectors reliably generalize to detecting their corresponding concepts in chat dialogues and web text. They form an interpretable geometry shared across models and can causally steer model behavior when injected into activations. entries.source_title: Galois Groups of Trinomials with Small Coefficients
entries.source_excerpt: We calculate the Galois group of $f = x^n + ax^k + b \in \mathbb{Z}\left[ x \right]$ over $\mathbb{Q}$ for all $1 \leq \left| ab \right| \leq 3$, $n$ sufficiently large and $k$ coprime to $n$. In particular, we prove that the Galois group of $f$ is the maximal one that its factorization type allows. We do it by proving a new sufficient condition for the Galois group of a factor of a trinomial to be symmetric, which perhaps can be used to derive stronger results of this kind in the future.

entries.source_title: Quasi-Monte Carlo based meshfree methods for parabolic equations on parameterized Riemannian manifolds
entries.source_excerpt: We develop and analyze a randomized path sampling framework for the pointwise approximation of linear parabolic equations on parameterized Riemannian manifolds, treating both closed manifolds and manifolds with Dirichlet boundary. Based on the Feynman-Kac representation, we construct a parameter-coordinate retraction-based discretization, referred to as the p-Ret scheme, for the manifold diffusion generated by the uniformly elliptic operator, and use it to formulate the Monte Carlo (MC) and randomized quasi-Monte Carlo (RQMC) methods. We derive the local weak consistency of the p-Ret transition and first-order weak convergence of the temporal discretization on closed manifolds. For fixed $h$, we show that RQMC sampling yields asymptotically faster variance decay than standard MC. On closed manifolds, the variance is $o(n^{-1})$ and, under additional regularity, satisfies the sharper bound $O(n^{-2+\varepsilon})$ for any $\varepsilon>0$. entries.source_title: Cortex: A Fixed-Point Theory of Governed Coding Agents - Technical Report
entries.source_excerpt: A coding agent combines a large language model (LLM) with a harness that plans, edits, and executes code. We study Cortex, a supervisory layer for pre-execution governance, requirement tracking, and iterative validation and repair. We formalize requirement closure on a finite lattice. For a fixed requirement set and a sound, monotone validation rule with persistent evidence, exhaustive iteration reaches the least fixed point with no more strict increases than there are requirements. Fair consequence scheduling reaches the same closure. A separate stochastic model bounds expected completion time under a uniform positive-progress assumption. These results depend on their stated assumptions; artifact repair, fallible validation, and finite execution budgets do not satisfy them automatically. We define Gauntlet's trajectory-similarity and build-gated scores, attack-success estimators, Wilson intervals, and case-cluster bootstrap summaries. Effective-feedback accounting counts newly certified requirements, rather than estimating their information value or utility. The five evaluation families support raw-versus-governed comparisons. entries.source_title: Classification of bipartite observables I: stable and uniformly stable observables
entries.source_excerpt: When two quantum systems are prepared independently and each is driven to an idealized limit, the expectation of a bipartite observable may depend on which system is idealized first. We call an observable stable when it does not. We show that stability is equivalent to two operational properties. First, every idealized preparation of one system can be simulated to arbitrary accuracy, uniformly over all probes, by finite mixtures of actual preparations, provided that the probing system is idealized first. Second, any two idealized preparations have a unique, symmetric independent product. Under a uniform form of stability, we prove, the number of preparations that $n$ adaptive probes can tell apart at a fixed margin is bounded by a polynomial in $n$, and responses can be learned with a bounded number of mistakes; otherwise, at some margin, protocols with $n$ probes tell apart $2^n$ preparations. The swap test, Hong--Ou--Mandel coincidences and discrete equality tests turn out to be uniformly stable, with bounds independent of the dimension, while order comparisons of discrete spectra unbounded above are unstable. entries.source_excerpt: There is growing interest in automating business activities with Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) due to latter's seeming ease of use. Never has it been easier, or costlier, to do less with more. However, little is known about when agents are preferable to established alternatives such as local computation, Representational State Transfer (REST), the Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP), and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), particularly when development speed, performance, and operational cost are considered. We investigate this question using a controlled mathematical task that compares seven methods on a benchmark of 1,000 arithmetic expressions where semantics of operator precedence has to be preserved. entries.source_title: Numerical Analysis for a Nonlinear Coupled Thermoelastic System with Acoustic Boundary Conditions
entries.source_excerpt: This paper presents the first $L^2$-norm error analysis for a nonlinear thermoelastic system with acoustic boundary conditions. The model involves three coupled variables: the acoustic potential $u$, the temperature $\theta$, and the normal displacement to the boundary $\delta$, with nonlinearities $|u|^d u$ in the domain and $g(\cdot,u')$ on the boundary, in addition to a nonlocal term $\beta(\int_\Omega\theta dx)\Delta\theta$ in the heat equation. We establish error estimates for the fully discrete problem, using the Crank-Nicolson method for time discretization and finite element method with basis of degree $r \geqslant 1$ for space discretization. We demonstrate that the domain-boundary coupling induces a half-power loss in the spatial convergence order for the variable $u$, and this effect propagates to the remaining variables due to the thermoelastic and boundary couplings, resulting in the final error estimate $\mathcal{O}(h^{r+\frac{1}{2}} + \tau^2)$. entries.source_title: Four colours are needed for closed-neighbourhood conflict-free colouring of all planar graphs
entries.source_excerpt: A colouring of the vertices of a graph is conflict-free with respect to closed neighbourhoods if every closed neighbourhood contains a colour that appears on exactly one of its vertices. The colouring need not be proper. Every planar graph has such a colouring with four colours. Fabrici, Lu\v{z}ar, Rindo\v{s}ov\'a and Sot\'ak conjectured that three colours always suffice. We disprove this conjecture. We give a simple gadget construction that turns every planar graph of chromatic number four into a planar graph with no such colouring with three colours. This also shows that it is NP-complete to decide whether three colours suffice for a planar graph. We also give a planar graph on $25$ vertices that needs four colours. Further, we give critical planar graphs on $25$ vertices with $52$ and with $51$ edges, an infinite family of plane triangulations that need four colours, and an infinite family of critical examples.
