entries.source_title: $R$-trivial Galois cohomology classes and cohomological $p$-dimension
entries.source_excerpt: Given a prime $p$, a field $F$ of characteristic different from $p$ and a finite $p$-primary Galois module $V$, a Galois cohomology class in $H^n(F,V)$ is called $R$-trivial if it can be connected to $0$ by a class defined over an open subscheme of the projective line. All classes of $H^n(F,V)$ are $R$-trivial if $F$ has cohomological $p$-dimension at most $n$, by the Bloch-Kato conjecture. We show that this bound is sharp: working over fields of iterated Laurent series, we produce, for every $n\geq 1$, a field $F$ of cohomological $p$-dimension $n+1$ and a Galois module $V$ such that $H^n(F,V)$ contains classes which are not $R$-trivial. The module $V$ is a quotient of the permutation module on the affine hyperplanes of an elementary abelian $p$-group, arising as a quotient of the absolute Galois group of $F$. We also describe $R$-trivial classes as sums of corestrictions of cup products involving a Kummer class.

entries.source_title: Sharp zero forcing numbers for the generalized Petersen graphs $P(n,3)$ and $P(n,4)$
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that $Z(P(n,3))=8$ for every $n\ge13$ and $Z(P(n,4))=10$ for every $n\ge18$, with both stabilization thresholds sharp, and give the exact values for all smaller admissible $n$. The first equality proves Krishnan's Conjecture 5; his Proposition 4 supplies its upper bound. The lower bounds use the external boundary of the first forcing sources: ten vertices have boundary at least eight in $P(n,3)$ for $n\ge14$, and sixteen vertices have boundary at least ten in $P(n,4)$ for $n\ge20$. Deletion within an empty column interval reduces these assertions to finite checks, and forts settle the remaining cases. The $k=3$ stabilization theorem has a Lean 4 formalization; the $k=4$ proof uses 89 boundary formulas and 11 fort formulas with separately checked DRAT certificates, together with explicit forcing sequences.

entries.source_title: Recovering Dirichlet coefficients from even samples
entries.source_excerpt: In this work, we determine the exact case error for recovering a Dirichlet coefficient from finitely many positive even samples with bounded additive errors. For sequences with a bounded tail and an unrestricted initial block, a polynomial estimator is minimax among all recovery maps. Its tail and noise constants admit explicit product formulas. We prove a sharp tail asymptotic on the index scale K^(3/2) and give a terminating procedure for selecting the sample count from a computable error bound.

entries.source_title: The geometric exceptional set for Fano threefolds
entries.source_excerpt: We study the geometric exceptional set in Manin's conjecture for smooth Fano threefolds. We prove that every adjoint rigid surface with $a$-invariant one on a non-product smooth Fano threefold is normal. This yields a description of the geometric exceptional set in terms of the higher-$a$ locus, anticanonical conics, and del Pezzo fibrations. Zariski density arise only from the latter two contributions. For del Pezzo fibrations, we construct a finite collection of parameter covers which controlling the associated breaking maps. We classify their low-genus components for general smooth Fano threefolds yielding examples with potentially Zariski dense geometric exceptional sets in $22$ of the $105$ deformation families. Extending Batyrev-Tschinkel's example, we construct Fano fourfolds with quartic del Pezzo fibrations and an explicit Fano threefold with two degree-six del Pezzo fibrations, all with Zariski dense geometric exceptional sets. For this threefold, the original form of Manin's conjecture fails on every non-empty open subset for every anticanonical height.
entries.title_zh: Fano 三维簇的几何例外集

entries.source_title: The Kemeny-Braess Paradox in Random Graphs
entries.source_excerpt: In 2016, Kirkland and Zeng initiated the mathematical treatment of Braess paradox for random walks on graphs using Kemeny's constant as the measure of travel time. We study this phenomenon for the Erd\H{o}s-R\'enyi random graph $G(n,p)$. An edge in a connected graph is called Kemeny-Braess if its deletion preserves connectedness and decreases Kemeny's constant, while a nonedge is Kemeny-Braess if its insertion increases Kemeny's constant. Let $\bar d=(n-1)p$ be the expected degree of $G\sim G(n,p)$, and assume that $\bar d-\log n\to\infty$, so that $G$ is connected with high probability. We determine the sharp asymptotic thresholds for the existence of both types of paradoxical behaviour. With $C^*=1/(1-\log 2)$, the threshold for Kemeny-Braess edges is $\bar d=C^*\log n$, whereas the threshold for Kemeny-Braess nonedges is $\bar d=2C^*\log n$. Hence, as the expected degree $\bar d$ increases, the connected regime exhibits three phases: first Kemeny-Braess paradox occurs for both edges and nonedges, then only for nonedges, and finally it disappears. entries.source_title: Constructive Universal Approximation by Infinite-Dimensional Neural Networks via Gaussian-Weighted Ridgelet Transform
entries.source_excerpt: Neural networks whose inputs are functions, as in operator learning, are usually shown to be universal by existence arguments, either by reduction to finite-dimensional networks or by Stone--Weierstrass-type density; these prove that approximants exist but say little about how the parameters depend on the target. We take a constructive route. We extend the ridgelet transform, an integral transform related to the Fourier, Radon, and wavelet transforms, to continuous maps on a separable infinite-dimensional Hilbert space, replacing the Lebesgue measure that is unavailable in infinite dimensions by Gaussian weights with a homogeneous mixture on the direction space. The resulting transform has a Plancherel identity and reconstruction formulas incorporating the frame operator, the correction induced by the weights, and it assigns to each target an explicit coefficient measure, one for every admissible analysis filter. The first round (9 October 2026) gave four values: $A(27,6,11)\ge 19305$, $A(27,6,12)\ge 24453$, $A(28,6,10)\ge 18642$ and $A(28,6,9)\ge 11154$, together with an explicit $A(24,6,12)$ code of 5566 words, now in the table's list of lost codes. Every code is a union of orbits of the semilinear affine group $\mathrm{A\Gamma L}(1,27)$, its index-2 subgroup, or $\mathrm{AGL}(1,23)$, acting on all but at most two coordinates. The orbits were chosen by maximum-weight independent set search on the orbit conflict graph: branch and bound in the first round, iterated local search in the second. entries.source_title: Derived equivalences and isogenies of supersingular abelian varieties
entries.source_excerpt: We study (twisted) Fourier-Mukai partners of supersingular abelian varieties. We give a simple proof that any two supersingular abelian varieties of the same dimension at least two are derived isogenous, answering a question raised by Li, Lu, and Tang and generalizing the result of Li and Zou. Moreover, in every dimension greater than two, we construct derived-equivalent supersingular abelian varieties whose corresponding positive powers are never isomorphic. We also give conditions under which derived equivalence between two supersingular principally polarized abelian varieties implies that their underlying abelian varieties are isomorphic. In particular, this implication holds in dimensions at most three.

entries.source_title: Think More or Read More? A Token-Budget Theory of Reasoning with Shared Context
entries.source_excerpt: Reasoning systems increasingly improve answers by incorporating additional context into the model's input, from multi-agent debate, where agents read their peers' responses, to self-refinement, where a model revisits its own drafts. In these systems, communication consumes context as one agent's output becomes another's input. We study the regime where token reading and generation draw on one fixed token window, so every token spent reading is a token that cannot be spent reasoning. We develop a \textbf{token-budget theory} that formalizes this trade-off, modeling accuracy as a function of the reasoning budget remaining after reading and aggregating votes with a Condorcet jury model that permits correlated errors. For multi-agent debate, the theory gives a closed-form prediction for the optimal number of agents. This quantity is estimated from single-agent measurements, allowing the optimal group size to be determined without running debate, and the same accounting extends to a heterogeneous set of different models. entries.source_title: Margin Certificates for Voting Classifiers under Mixing Dependence
entries.source_excerpt: Margin bounds explain why weighted votes generalize after training error vanishes, but dependent observations require concentration arguments that keep the dependence model and failure budget explicit. We study stationary mixing streams without treating dependence as a formal substitution of an "effective sample size." For a finite base class, we combine independent-block Rademacher theory for stationary $\beta$-mixing processes with a clipped margin loss to obtain an explicit uniform voting-margin certificate, whose dependence penalty is set by the number of approximately independent blocks and the coupling budget $4(\mu-1)\beta(a)$. A black-box transfer theorem shows that any i.i.d. voting-margin guarantee remains valid on a regularly spaced subsequence, with only an additive $\beta$-mixing failure probability. For votes fixed independently of a stationary finite-state reversible Markov stream, spectral concentration gives the cleaner $\sqrt{t_{rel}/n}$ rate, and a sticky-refresh construction shows this exponent is unavoidable. entries.source_title: Lean4AgenticRL: Advancing Agentic RL with Verifiable Multi-level Process Rewards
entries.source_excerpt: Enhancing the agentic capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to tackle complex software engineering (SWE) and general terminal-usage problems is a pressing challenge. Current state-of-the-art LLMs often go through large-scale agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL). However, they mostly rely on high-level outcome rewards, with minimal consideration of low-level toolcall and mid-level workflow-stage rewards, which makes the training less effective. To overcome this limitation, we propose **Lean4AgenticRL**, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first framework that grounds multi-level process rewards in the unified Lean4 formalization schema for open-ended agentic RL. **Lean4AgenticRL** first builds a *problem-specific workflow* system that balances the agent's own capability and controllability during execution, laying the foundation for further verification. Subsequently, our workflow formalization and multi-level reward annotation methods enable agent behavior verification within a general harness system. entries.source_title: Generic vanishing for Dolbeault cohomology of mixed Hodge modules on abelian varieties
entries.source_excerpt: We study generic vanishing for the Dolbeault cohomology of mixed Hodge modules, where the differentials in the Dolbeault complex are modified by a one-form. We prove that, on the Dolbeault moduli space of Higgs line bundles, the cohomology support loci of mixed Hodge modules agree with the images of the cohomology support loci of their underlying $\mathscr{D}$-modules on the de Rham moduli space under the map induced by the nonabelian Hodge correspondence. We further apply this result to study Fourier-Mukai transforms of mixed Hodge modules on abelian varieties. We show that the extended Fourier-Mukai transform for bounded complexes of mixed Hodge modules has cohomology sheaves that are flat over the twistor line of $\lambda$-connections. This also gives an extension of Fourier transform of mixed Hodge modules to a compactification of the de Rham moduli space.
entries.title_zh: 阿贝尔簇上混合 Hodge 模的 Dolbeault 上同调一般消失

entries.source_title: A Non-Split Motohashi Formula for Toric Periods over Number Fields
entries.source_excerpt: We establish a non-split Motohashi formula for toric Eisenstein periods over an arbitrary number field $F$. For a quadratic extension $E/F$, we compare toric Fourier inversion for a product of two Eisenstein series with the $\mathrm{GL}_2/F$-spectral expansion of its Rankin--Selberg kernel. The kernel regularizes the product in a cone of absolute convergence. Eisenstein corrections and contour residues give the geometric and residual terms in the meromorphically continued identity. Suitable test data give twisted first- and second-moment formulas for the completed $L$-functions of everywhere unramified toric characters. Over general $F$ these provide an adelic counterpart of the moment formulas of Duke--Friedlander--Iwaniec that does not use the geometry of Heegner points. In the CM case, we prove the absolute nonvanishing proportion $4.9\times10^{-4}$ for every totally real base field and all sufficiently large CM discriminants, with the threshold depending on the base field and no restriction on the number of ramified primes. We incorporate inverse Euler factors at small ramified primes into the mollifier. Local unit-group tests con
entries.title_zh: 数域上的非分裂 Motohashi 环积分公式
entries.summary_zh: 论文对任意数域 F 建立非分裂的 Motohashi 公式：针对二次扩张 E/F，把两个 Eisenstein 级数乘积的环 Fourier 反演与 GL₂/F 的 Rankin–Selberg 核谱展开联系起来，并用 Eisenstein 修正项和留数处理亚纯延拓。由此得到处处非分歧环特征的完备 L 函数扭曲一阶、二阶矩公式；在 CM 情形，对每个全实基域及充分大的 CM 判别式，证明绝对非消失比例至少 4.9×10⁻⁴，阈值依赖基域且不限制分歧素数个数。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合研究 L 函数矩与 CM 场算术的人，结果把经典矩方法推广到一般数域的 adelic 框架。
entries.pragmatic_review: 非消失比例给出明确的定量应用，但阈值仍需估计。
entries.cynic_review: 定量下界较小且只适用于充分大判别式，适用边界很重要。
entries.paper_review: 摘要明确陈述公式、矩估计与非消失结论，技术假设需阅读全文确认。

entries.source_title: Training-Free Prompt Selection for Efficient Reinforcement Learning With Partial Rollouts
entries.source_excerpt: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a prominent paradigm for training reasoning models, but its computational cost makes efficient data selection increasingly important. Since training examples contribute unequally to learning, selecting a small, informative subset can offer a more efficient alternative to using the entire data pool. The training-free selection method estimates prompt value with hidden states from complete greedy rollouts. However, in our datasets, $26$--$32\%$ of these rollouts fail to terminate within the generation budget. We introduce LIFT, a training-free data selector that identifies impactful prompts using only partial reasoning rollouts. At its core, LIFT uses Partial Rollout Context Lift (PRCL), a score inspired by pointwise $\mathcal{V}$-information that accumulates token-level log-likelihood ratios between a question-conditioned context and a null context with the question removed. This enables prompt scoring from a short rollout prefix rather than a complete trajectory. Across Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B, prefixes retaining at least 90\% and 95\% of the f

entries.source_title: Weakly uniform computable categoricity and function composition
entries.source_excerpt: We introduce the definition of a weakly $X$-uniformly $Y$-computably categorical structure, relativizing a definition of Kudinov (1996), and show that this relativized notion is closely related to the 2-dimensional complexity of the pairs of partial functions $(f,g)$ with the property that the composition $g\circ f$ simulates convergent $\emptyset'$-oracle computations. We develop a general theory for computing via composition and use it to prove results about the surprisingly complex weakly uniform categoricity spectrum of the structure $(\omega,S)$ where $S(n)=n+1$. Namely, that $(\omega,S)$ is w.$X$.u.$Y$.c.c. for some $X\not\geq_T\emptyset'$ and $Y<_T\emptyset'$, but $(\omega,S)$ is not w.$X$.u.$Y$.c.c. for any $X<_T\emptyset'$ and $Y\not\geq_T\emptyset'$. We also construct a computably categorical structure that is not w.$\emptyset'$.u.c.c., but is w.$X$.u.c.c. for a set $X$ that is $\leq_T$-incomparable with $\emptyset'$.
entries.title_zh: 弱一致可计算范畴性与函数复合

entries.source_title: Energy of signed graphs and the vertex cover number
entries.source_excerpt: The energy $\mathcal{E}(\Gamma)$ of a signed graph $\Gamma=(G,\sigma)$ is the sum of the absolute values of the eigenvalues of its adjacency matrix $A(\Gamma)$. In this article, we prove that $\mathcal{E}(\Gamma)\geq 2\tau(G)$, where $\tau(G)$ is the vertex cover number of $G$. The case of unsigned graphs, a 1980s conjecture proved only recently, is a special case of this result. Moreover, we completely characterize the equality case: equality holds if and only if every connected component of $\Gamma$ is switching equivalent to an \emph{additive rook graph} $\Rook_N(a,b)$. This graph is constructed on an $N\times N$ board with $a_i+b_j$ vertices on square $(i,j)$. Two vertices are joined by a positive edge if they share only a row, and by a negative edge if they share only a column. As consequences, we obtain a balanced/antibalanced trichotomy for the extremal signed graphs and deduce the characterization of the extremal unsigned graphs. Finally, an example shows that the bound does not extend to the Hermitian adjacency matrices of mixed graphs or to complex unit gain graphs.
entries.title_zh: 符号图能量与顶点覆盖数

entries.source_title: Anisotropic Representation Dynamics in Transformers
entries.source_excerpt: Small differences between internal representations can shrink or grow as they pass through a Transformer layer, affecting how information is preserved and how sensitive the model is to perturbations. Yet it remains unclear when changes in attention weights can turn a representation difference that would otherwise shrink into one that grows. We develop a \textbf{Mixture-Gated Theory of Anisotropic Representation Dynamics} that separates self-attention into value transport, query gating, and key gating. Our analysis reveals how the geometry of attended representations constrains gating and how interactions between these mechanisms can reverse contraction induced by value transport. We formalize this phenomenon as gating-induced regime switching, where a representation difference contracts under fixed attention routing but expands under full attention. We derive a necessary and sufficient spectral criterion that certifies the existence or absence of switching and identifies switching directions without exhaustive search. entries.source_title: Bengali Hallucination Detection with Retrieval and Programs: A System Study
entries.source_excerpt: Bengali hallucination detection must distinguish unsupported factual claims from incorrect reasoning, often without a supplied reference passage. We present and characterize an inference-only system that combines response-conditioned query rewriting, hybrid retrieval, and task-specific language-model judging. Six retrieval routes search question-answer and passage collections; a router directs each example to a 27B textual judge or a 14B agent that can compare retrieved answers, reason directly, or generate and execute Python. We characterize the system using version-specific code, saved predictions, execution traces, and corpus metadata from the Olikbochon challenge. Kaggle associates a displayed private macro-F1 of 0.956 with Version 2; its saved run processes 2,516 examples in 220.99 minutes on two T4 GPUs. Of 253 math-routed examples, 88 terminate through candidate matching, while execution traces expose 49 stderr-bearing run events across 35 examples. entries.source_title: A Kleene-inspired sequent system for a minimal logic of evidence and truth
entries.source_excerpt: This paper investigates the proof theory of the logic of evidence and truth LETFm, with the aim of obtaining a sequent calculus consisting only of logical rules, suitable for a simple bottom-up decision procedure. We begin with G1f, a sequent system containing structural rules, which makes explicit the main difficulties in obtaining a fully logical and decidable calculus for LETFm. We then introduce G3f, a G3-style system obtained from by applying Kleene's trick, which absorbs contraction into the logical rules by adding the principal formula of the rule to its premises.

entries.source_title: The exact Euclidean window of $\mathbb{Z}[\sqrt{14}]$
entries.source_excerpt: Let $R = \mathbb{Z}[\sqrt{14}]$, let $\pi = 4 + \sqrt{14}$, and let $\mathfrak{p} = (2,\sqrt{14}) = \pi R$ be the prime ideal above $2$. Cavallar and Lemmermeyer studied the multiplicative weighted norms $\phi_{t}(x) = |N(x)|(t/2)^{v_{\pi}(x)}$ and asked for which weights $t$ they are Euclidean functions on $R$. We show that the set of these weights, the Euclidean window of $\mathfrak{p}$, is $(\sqrt{5},T]$, where $T$ is the algebraic number \[ T = \sqrt{\frac{8}{104051\sqrt{2} - 55617\sqrt{7}}} = 2.2468286690\ldots = \sqrt{5} + 0.0107606915\ldots. \] Thus the window is nonempty but not open. We also obtain the integer-valued completely multiplicative Euclidean function $2^{v_{\pi}(x)}|N(x)|^{6}$ on $R$.

entries.source_title: Identify, Classify, Act: Per-Instruction Controlled Compliance for LLMs over External Data
entries.source_excerpt: LLMs over external data face a per-instruction tension: a single document or tool return often interleaves legitimate directives with adversarial prompt injections, and the model must follow the former while rejecting the latter. Existing defenses suppress or trust all external instructions, collapsing the safety-utility frontier and forcing a choice between over-refusal and over-compliance. We argue the missing capability is \textbf{per-instruction credit attribution} and formalize it as External-Data Instruction Classification, an identify-classify-act decision over each embedded directive. We propose \textbf{EDIC}, a decomposed reward framework for per-instruction compliance. A scene-grounded pipeline injects mixed beneficial and harmful instructions with counterfactual filtering, while a generative judge is initialized by SFT and refined with GRPO to attribute compliance at the instruction level. The judge then produces a reward that separately encourages beneficial compliance and penalizes harmful compliance for RL training. entries.source_title: PArcK trees can get as hot as you want
entries.source_excerpt: We consider the combinatorial game Partizan Arc Kayles as a generalization of Domineering. An extensive technical search using genetic algorithms found hot positions of temperature exceeding 2. We discuss this search and construct a family of positions with high temperature that includes these graphs and prove that Partizan Arc Kayles has unbounded temperature. We identify an infinite family of second-player win positions as part of our main construction.

entries.source_title: A configurational numerical viscosity for thermodynamically compatible finite volume schemes of compressible multiphase flows
entries.source_excerpt: We consider the fluid subsystem of a variationally derived hyperbolic thermodynamically compatible (HTC) model of compressible multiphase flows. Its total energy is in general not convex in the natural state variables, so a scalar numerical viscosity acting on them need not produce non-negative entropy. Reformulating the equations in terms of the volume fractions separates changes in the amount of each phase from changes in its intrinsic state. This guides the construction of a configurational numerical viscosity in phase variables, in which the energy is convex, while the scheme retains the structure of the HTC model. At the semi-discrete level, the new schemes satisfy: I) local conservation of the phase masses, the mixture momentum and the total energy; II) a cell entropy inequality whose production is non-negative face by face and phase by phase, with no convexity assumption in the evolved variables and no clipping; III) positivity of the partial densities and volume fractions under explicit time-step conditions; IV) exact preservation of contact equilibria; V) equivalence with a scheme for the density-weighted volume fractions. entries.source_title: Volterra-Skorokhod Reflection and Fluid Limits of Loss Queues
entries.source_excerpt: In the $G_t/G/n/n$ loss queue, a customer blocked at time $u$ remains missing from the system for as long as it would have been served. A fraction $K(t-u)$ of the blocking at $u$ therefore still affects the occupancy at time $t$, where $K=1-G$ is the service survival function. We show that, for every arrival process satisfying a functional strong law of large numbers, the fluid limit of this queue is a reflection with kernel $K$ of the fluid limit of the associated infinite-server queue. The reflection is defined by a one-sided reflection problem on $(-\infty,1]$ in which the regulator is convolved with a memory kernel. Given a c\`adl\`ag input $\rho$ and a kernel $K$ with $K(0)=1$, we seek a pair $(\hat\rho,\eta)$ such that $\hat\rho=\rho-\int_0^\cdot K(\cdot-u)\,d\eta(u)$ takes values in $(-\infty,1]$, $\eta$ is nondecreasing, and $\eta$ increases only when $\hat\rho=1$. We refer to this problem as the Volterra-Skorokhod problem. We show existence and uniqueness of the solution and that the solution map is Lipschitz continuous in the uniform norm and nonanticipating. entries.source_title: A Central Limit Theorem for Intrinsic Fr\'echet Means on Real Grassmannians
entries.source_excerpt: Subspace-valued data arise in dimension reduction, image-set and video recognition, and signal processing, and the Fr\'echet mean is their standard sample mean [11,9,15,23]. We establish a central limit theorem for the intrinsic sample Fr\'echet mean of i.i.d. observations on the real Grassmann manifold $\mathrm{Gr}(p,n)$, as a specialization of the general theorem of [18]. Unlike prior results which require the distribution to vanish or place negligible mass near the cut locus of the population mean, we allow a continuous, possibly positive density. To enable our results, we derive two properties of $\mathrm{Gr}(p,n)$: the first is that the union of the cut loci of all points within distance $\delta$ of the mean has volume $O(\delta)$. The second is that the Hessian of the squared distance function is integrable. We also give a smooth density on $\mathrm{Gr}(1,2)$ for which the mean is unique but the Fr\'echet Hessian vanishes.

entries.source_title: Reusable QUBO-Derived Block-Schur Inverse Factors for Fixed-Operator Finite-Difference PDE Solvers
entries.source_excerpt: Many simulations of partial differential equations require the repeated solution of linear systems whose matrix remains fixed while the righthand side changes. We present a hybrid offline online framework for this setting. The discretized operator is organized into small coupled blocks and reduced through block Schur complements. Instead of expressing the complete PDE solution as one large binary optimization problem, quadratic unconstrained binary optimization is used only to construct reusable local inverse factors. These factors are computed during an offline stage, decoded and stored, and then reused in an ordinary classical block solve for subsequent righthand sides. The optimizer facing problem size is governed by the local block size and chosen numerical precision, rather than by the dimension of the full spatial grid. We develop the mathematical formulation, analyze the accuracy and resource requirements of the binary representation, and examine the method on representative finite difference PDE problems, including execution of the local optimization stage on quantum optimization hardware. entries.source_title: CME-SpectrumBench: Can LLMs Analyze Condensed Matter Spectral Data?
entries.source_excerpt: Large Language Models (LLMs) are presently well assessed by expert-level mathematics and physics benchmarks which focus on theoretical, symbolic reasoning. However, we lack experimental benchmarks that evaluate data analysis in frontier research problems, a capability that future domain-specific foundation models must have. To this end, we present CME-SpectrumBench, an expert-designed benchmark consisting of 190 questions that measures how reliably frontier LLMs analyze research-level spectral scientific data in condensed matter experiments (CME). Using simulated CME spectral data, we prompt models to identify structures from 2D intensity arrays in the face of noise and limited instrumental resolution, a test of dense context reasoning. Models are scored by how accurately their numerical answers approach the ground truth. Under direct query, scores generally pale in comparison to handwritten code due to clear failure modes: models can find simple features but struggle to trace patterns or compute derived quantities, and performance typically degrades with increased data resolution and noise/convolution levels. entries.source_title: Batched Contextual Reinforcement II: Does RLVR Need Long Rollout Windows?
entries.source_excerpt: Long rollout windows make reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) expensive, yet simply shortening them can remove the correctness signal: when every single-problem rollout truncates before an answer, group-relative accuracy advantages vanish. As a technical continuation of Batched Contextual Reinforcement (BCR), we study how concurrent rewards relax this dependence on long windows. Concurrent Constraint Reinforcement (CCR) places three independently verifiable problems in one capped training completion. Correct answers completed before truncation retain credit, while a shared budget encourages shorter useful reasoning without an explicit length penalty. We connect this mechanism to conditional reward- and update-variance analyses and study 4B and 8B mathematical reasoning models. Against single-problem GRPO with a 32k window, CCR with an 8,000-token window reduces tokens per training step from 975,464 to 174,957 on 4B and from 793,832 to 165,788 on 8B, saving 82.1% and 79.1%, respectively. entries.title_zh: 批处理上下文强化 II：可验证奖励强化学习需要长 rollout 窗口吗？

entries.source_title: On the classification of threefold flops
entries.source_excerpt: We show that possibly singular threefold flopping contractions are completely classified by their associated derived contraction algebras, considered up to derived Morita equivalence; in contrast to the smooth case the extra derived structure is necessary in general. This extends previous work of the author on simple flops, and follows from a more general theorem about isolated hypersurface singularities. The key new input is to show that derived localisation at a Hochschild class is Morita invariant; this result raises some interesting questions related to the classification of recollements. We also show that derived contraction algebras admit a deformation-theoretic interpretation in families in a general setting that encompasses threefold flops, flips, and divisor-to-curve contractions.
entries.title_zh: 三维 flop 的分类

entries.source_title: No-Regret Revenue Maximization in Sequential Market Making Under Inventory Constraints
entries.source_excerpt: Market makers keep trading efficient by setting bid and ask prices for buyers and sellers. In sequential market making, trades happen independently based on price thresholds, requiring the market maker to maintain balanced, low-risk inventory over T rounds. This paper studies how to maximize revenue with unknown buyer and seller valuations using regret minimization. When the market maker only sees trade success or failure, an algorithm achieves regret and inventory bounds proportional to T to the power of 2/3. When full order book data is available for failed trades, regret and inventory limits improve significantly to the square root of T. We also establish a fundamental trade-off via a lower bound, by proving that tighter round-by-round inventory limits strictly force higher minimum regret.

entries.source_title: Codimension of Brill-Noether Loci on Abelian Surfaces and the First Segre Invariant
entries.source_excerpt: Let $X$ be an abelian surface of Picard rank 1 with ample generator $H$. We show that, for a Mukai vector $\mathbf{v}=(r,mH,\chi)$ with $r,m\geq 1$ and $\chi\leq 0$, the first Brill-Noether loci $\{E \;|\; H^0(E)\neq 0\}$ in $M_X(\mathbf{v})$ is nonempty of the expected codimension $1-\chi$. As an application, we study the rank 1 Segre invariant on these abelian surfaces. Specifically, for $\mathbf{v}$ a Mukai vector of a $\mu$-stable sheaf of $\mathrm{rank}\geq 2$, we compute the Segre invariant of the general sheaf in $M_X(\mathbf{v})$, and we determine the numbers which arise as the Segre invariant of a sheaf in $M_X(\mathbf{v})$.

entries.source_title: LogicVal:A Logic-Formalized Benchmark for Constraint Satisfaction in Text-to-Image Generation
entries.source_excerpt: Text-to-Image (T2I) generative models have made significant progress in producing high-fidelity images from natural-language prompts. Alongside this progress, numerous benchmarks have been developed to evaluate capabilities such as attribute binding, numeracy, spatial reasoning, and commonsense reasoning. In this work, we propose a new perspective on T2I evaluation by casting it as a constraint-satisfaction problem. We introduce a logical framework that formally specifies the benchmark domain, including objects, attributes, and relations, alongside the constraints that generated images must satisfy. We evaluated four state-of-the-art T2I models across 9 classes of constraints ranging from a single-object-attribute to multi-object relationships constraints involving logical operators ($\forall, \exists, count, \rightarrow$). Our results reveal a substantial gap between single-object and complex conditional multi-object relationship constraint classes, with the best-performing model achieving 98% accuracy on the former and just 53% on the latter. entries.source_title: Nondimensionalization, Variational Inequalities and Uncertainty Quantification in a Morphoelastic Model for Burn Injury Healing
entries.source_excerpt: Mathematical modelling of burn injury healing involves coupling biological processes with mechanical deformation, resulting in computationally stiff, nonlinear partial differential equations that severely limit the scalability of existing numerical solutions. We present a computational framework addressing these challenges. By nondimensionalizing the model and performing scaling analysis, we show that chemotaxis and inertia are negligible, permitting a quasi-static momentum approach. To enforce non-negativity constraints, we implement a Variational Inequality formulation using the Finite Element Method in FEniCSx, and verify it via numerical convergence studies and mass balances. We identify high-order parameter interactions, specifically equilibrium collagen density and signalling dynamics, as the primary drivers of solver stability. A sensitivity analysis of nearly four million simulations reveals that isolated parameter variations predominantly govern the maximum wound contraction. entries.source_excerpt: We present \'{E}pi, an autonomous research agent that sustains investigations across model sessions and evolves its methods through accumulated experience. \'{E}pi combines persistent research history, hierarchical memory, branching and independent review to maintain research continuity, learn from experiments, and explore and revisit alternative approaches. Its experiments run across session boundaries, and a fixed verifier evaluates their outputs. \'{E}pi produced 120 record-setting results, comprising 20 numerical bound records across 12 families and 100 construction records across eight families. These include an approximately 84-fold narrower interval for the $n$-queens constant and a more than 3.6-million-fold narrower rigorous interval for the quartic Feigenbaum attractor dimension. Exact dual certificates establish that the Cohn-Elkies linear-programming bound cannot be sharp in dimensions 10 and 11. Beyond numerical improvements, \'{E}pi gives a computer-assisted proof of Tuza's conjecture for split graphs with an eight-vertex clique part and at most three triangle-active neighborhood types, with arbitrary multiplicities. entries.source_title: On the existence of mixed orthogonal arrays of strength two with six factors
entries.source_excerpt: Orthogonal arrays are foundational objects in combinatorial design theory and experimental design theory, with broad applications in computer science, coding theory, and cryptography. In this paper, we investigate the existence for mixed orthogonal arrays of strength two with six factors, and propose several new constructions based on incomplete orthogonal Latin squares, incomplete transversal designs, and $\Sigma$-resolvable transversal designs. As a result, we show that the necessary conditions for the existence of such mixed orthogonal arrays are also sufficient, except for a small number of known exceptions and nine unsettled cases.

entries.source_title: Preserving Reasoning Diversity in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards via Adaptive Replay
entries.source_excerpt: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but often reduces the diversity of their reasoning behaviors. We study this phenomenon from the perspective of finite-sample learning dynamics and show that limited on-policy rollouts can progressively suppress semantically distinct but equally rewarded reasoning modes. Once a mode becomes sufficiently under-sampled, standard on-policy RLVR rarely recovers it. Motivated by this observation, we propose TAR, a Targeted Adaptive Replay framework that preserves diverse correct reasoning behaviors already present in the base policy. TAR constructs a compact memory bank of diverse base-model solutions and selectively replays them through an adaptive mechanism that activates only when stored behaviors are being suppressed during RLVR. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two Qwen2.5 model scales, TAR consistently achieves a better balance between reasoning performance and diversity preservation than existing diversity-preserving post-training methods, while substantially reducing the forgetting of correct base-model
entries.title_zh: 用自适应回放在可验证奖励 RL 中保留推理多样性

entries.source_title: Hypercube Richardson varieties from magic words
entries.source_excerpt: Inspired by the recent preprint of Ellenberg, Libedinsky, Plaza, Simental, and Williamson, we study the geometry of Richardson varieties whose associated Bruhat intervals are boolean posets. We define magic words for a Bruhat interval and prove that for intervals with magic words the associated Richardson variety is a tower of $\mathbb{P}^1$-s. We also prove that the Bruhat intervals consisting of the dyadically well-distributed permutations all have magic words. This gives a new proof that they form a boolean poset.

entries.source_title: $a$-numbers of covers in characteristic two: semigroups and Riemann-Roch spaces
entries.source_excerpt: We compute the $a$-numbers of the Garcia-G\"uneri-Stichtenoth curves, the Beelen-Montanucci curves, and the Skabelund covers of Suzuki curves in characteristic two. The proofs use the identity $a(X)=\ell(\tfrac12\operatorname{div}(dt))$ and reduce the calculations to Riemann-Roch spaces on the base curves. We obtain transfer formulas for odd-degree radical covers, with one or several points at infinity, and evaluate them using Weierstrass semigroups and plane sections of the Hermitian curve. For the first two families we also give cyclic models over the projective line and relate the formulas to Elkin's rank formula. We then treat two classes of Artin-Schreier fibre products. A supersingular genus-six family has a-number $3$ at the zero parameter and $2$ elsewhere, although the genera and $a$-numbers of its quadratic quotients remain fixed. We determine its Ekedahl--Oort types as $(0,0,0,1,2,3)$ and $(0,1,1,2,3,4)$,
entries.title_zh: 特征二覆盖曲线的 a 数：半群与 Riemann–Roch 空间

entries.source_title: Analysis and approximation for inverse potential problem of space-dependent variable-exponent sub-diffusion in heterogeneous medium
entries.source_excerpt: Anomalous transport in complex heterogeneous medium is often characterized by non-Markovian memory effects and spatially varying trapping properties. From the point of view of continuous-time random walks, such heterogeneity can be described by a position-dependent heavy-tailed waiting-time density $q(t \mid x)\sim C(x)t^{-1-\alpha(x)}$, where $0<\alpha(x)<1$ is the local anomalous exponent. This microscopic interpretation naturally leads to the sub-diffusion with a space-dependent variable exponent $\alpha(x)$. Compared with constant-exponent models, the variable-exponent fractional operators generally do not commute with the spatial Laplacian, which makes both the forward and inverse analysis substantially more delicate. This paper investigates the inverse problem of recovering a spatially dependent radiative or potential coefficient in variable-exponent sub-diffusion from terminal observation data. We formulate the inverse problem as a nonlinear fixed-point equation and prove that the associated fixed-point operator is monotone such that the fixed-point iteration converges decreasingly to the unique solution. entries.source_title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
entries.source_excerpt: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
entries.title_zh: Cloudflare 安全审计 Skill：多阶段代码审计与结构化发现
entries.summary_zh: 这是一个供编程智能体使用的安全审计 Skill，将审计拆成侦察、按覆盖清单搜寻、候选验证、结构化输出、独立记录核验和报告生成六个阶段，并用覆盖台账和 findings.json 管理结果。项目称该 Skill 是 Cloudflare 漏洞发现流程的单仓库起点；材料描述了工作流和验证器，但没有提供独立审计效果或漏洞发现率数据。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 对构建代码审计 Agent 的人有参考价值，尤其是如何把覆盖范围、候选漏洞反证和最终记录核验变成可追踪流程；其对沙箱与网络隔离的要求也提示了自动化审计的部署边界。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可先借鉴其阶段划分和机器可读结果结构，再按团队代码库与隔离环境调整审计流程。
entries.cynic_review: 多阶段设计和独立验证能改善流程纪律，但不能单凭流程描述推断漏洞检出能力，且运行依赖隔离沙箱与并行子 Agent。
entries.paper_review: 材料列出 Skill 文档、JSON Schema、零依赖验证器及其测试文件，但没有给出测试运行记录或独立安全评估。

project_insight.translation_zh: 一个面向编程智能体的 Skill，可将智能体组织成多阶段安全审计流程，并输出经过独立核验的机器可读发现。流程包括：侦察并记录架构与覆盖范围；按覆盖清单分配搜寻任务并检查遗漏；让新的验证者尝试推翻候选问题；将结果写入 findings.json 并按 Schema 校验；由独立智能体核验最终记录中的源码依据；最后根据已验证记录和覆盖台账生成报告。发现分为 confirmed、needs_validation 和 rejected。项目要求使用支持工具调用和并行子 Agent 的编程智能体、Node.js 验证器，以及对目标代码构建与测试进行操作系统级隔离的沙箱；沙箱应禁用外网、使用受限环境并限制资源和写入路径。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 把单仓库安全审计组织为带覆盖台账、候选反证和独立记录核验的 Agent 工作流，并生成结构化发现与报告。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先阅读 SKILL.md、RECONNAISSANCE.md 和 VALIDATION-AND-REPORTING.md，理解流程与结果判定；检查仓库中的 Schema 和验证器后，再选择隔离良好的测试仓库试运行，并为构建、测试和目标代码准备禁网沙箱。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 这是 Skill 工作流而非独立安全扫描器，效果依赖编程智能体、子 Agent 和沙箱能力；项目要求操作系统级隔离、禁用外部网络并限制资源。材料未提供审计基准或独立效果评估；GitHub 页面标注 MIT 许可。
use_cases_zh: 为个人开源项目设计可复查的 Agent 代码安全审计流程。
研究如何通过覆盖台账和候选验证减少安全审计中的遗漏与误报。
参考其 findings.json Schema 和验证器，为内部安全工具搭建结构化结果管线。

entries.source_title: Thinking Hard Above AI
entries.source_excerpt: There are many ways in which AI is generating uncertainty in mathematics. We are not sure how it will impact our jobs, it is raising questions about how it might affect academic training, and it is not clear how it might change the job search process and how we evaluate research. This is by no means an exhaustive list. In this post, I will focus two another related questions, which are: “Is there still any mathematics to be done? And will doing mathematics still be fun and interesting?” I believe that there is, and here I set out to explain why.
entries.title_zh: 在 AI 之上继续认真思考数学

entries.source_title: Strict monotonicity of weighted inhomogeneous percolation thresholds under covering maps
entries.source_excerpt: We study Bernoulli bond percolation under weak covering maps for a class of weighted inhomogeneous product measures such that each edge $e$ carries a positive weight $w(e)$ and is open at intensity $\lambda\geq 0$ with probability $1-\exp(-\lambda w(e))$. We prove a strict monotonicity of the weighted critical intensities $\lambda_c$ in the covering compatibility setting under bounded degree, uniform ellipticity, tame fibre and disjoint tree-lifting. While for the weighted uniform connection thresholds $\lambda_{\mathrm{conn}}$, we establish their strict monotonicity for non-injective weak covering maps under bounded degree, covering compatibility, uniform ellipticity, bounded-fibre and disjoint tree-lifting. Moreover, we verify a general-profile theorem on strict monotonicities of the two thresholds $\lambda_c$ and $\lambda_{\mathrm{conn}}$ respectively under explicit compact-interval finite-energy, derivative bounds and aforementioned geometric conditions.
entries.title_zh: 覆盖映射下加权非齐次渗流阈值的严格单调性
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究弱覆盖映射下的加权非齐次 Bernoulli 键渗流，其中边 e 以 1−exp(−λw(e)) 的概率开放，并证明在有界度、均匀椭圆性、纤维受控及不交树提升等条件下，覆盖兼容图的加权临界强度 λc 严格单调。对加权一致连通阈值 λ_conn，作者在非单射弱覆盖等额外条件下也得到严格单调性，并将结论推广到满足有限能量和导数界的一般概率剖面。

entries.source_title: The Compactness Theorem for Enriched Logic
entries.source_excerpt: The framework of enriched logic extends positive logic (also known as coherent logic) from sets to structures internal to a symmetric monoidal closed category $\mathcal{V}$. This framework was developed by Rosick\'y and the second-named author. The main novelty of this logic is that the arities of the function and relation symbols are now objects in $\mathcal{V}$. We prove the compactness theorem for this enriched logic. That is, a set of $\mathcal{V}$-enriched sequents has a model (internal to $\mathcal{V}$) if every finite subset has a model. To achieve this, we define ultraproducts of enriched structures and prove enriched versions of {\L}os' theorem. We then develop some model-theoretic applications. entries.title_zh: 富逻辑的紧致性定理
entries.summary_zh: 论文把正逻辑（相干逻辑）推广到对称幺半闭范畴 V 内部的结构中，函数与关系符号的元数本身可以是 V 的对象，并证明相应紧致性：若一组 V-富化序列的每个有限子集都有内部模型，则整组也有模型。作者通过定义富化结构的超积并证明 Łoś 定理，再发展模型论图式方法，推出若干嵌合结果并奠定富化语法类型的基础；实例包括集合、预层拓扑、幺半群作用、阿贝尔群、富化范畴、偏序与伪度量空间。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合模型论与范畴逻辑研究者了解紧致性如何扩展至富化结构及其应用范围。

entries.cynic_review: 理论适用范围依赖 V 的范畴条件，不能把摘要中的实例视为无条件推广。

entries.source_title: Alp\"oge's counterexample to the JC, Economic Stabilization, and Zhao's Vanishing Conjecture
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we apply stabilization techniques which are economic in the number of added dimensions to a slightly tweaked version of Alp\"oge's counterexample to JC(3) and JC(3,7). The first idea which lead to more economic stabilization is to bypass the degree 3 reduction of Bass, Connell and Wright in the construction of a counterexample to HJC(n). We construct counterexamples to HJC(15), VC(28), and HVC(30). On the other hand, we will perform degree 3 reduction after all to obtain counterexamples of low degree. We construct counterexamples to JC(12,3), HJC(18,3), VC(34,4), and HVC(36,4). As an encore, we construct a cubic-linear counterexample to the Jacobian Conjecture in dimension 90. All presented counterexamples to the Jacobian Conjecture (Vanishing Conjecture) are over the (Gaussian) integers.
entries.title_zh: Alpöge 对 Jacobian 猜想反例、经济稳定化与 Zhao 消失猜想
entries.summary_zh: 作者将经济维度稳定化用于稍作调整的 Alpöge Jacobian 猜想反例，构造若干维数/次数版本的 Jacobian、广义 Jacobian 与消失猜想反例；进一步给出 90 维的 cubic-linear Jacobian 猜想反例。摘要称所有 Jacobian/Vanishing 反例定义在高斯整数上，工作展示如何控制把低维反例稳定化时增加的维数。

entries.source_title: A sound pure type system with ranks as sorts and Type-in-Type
entries.source_excerpt: We present a dependently typed pure type system that contains a circular axiom $s : s$ for a certain sort $s$ and is nonetheless strongly normalizing. Girard's paradox is avoided because our sorts are not closed under a $\Pi$-former: function types are placed in sorts according to their rank. Turns out that this system has a unique set of characteristics: it has similar normalization behaviour as STLC (so complexity of normalization is TOWER-complete) while at the same time allowing non-uniform representation of arbitrary elementary recursive functions; furthermore, it has a nontrivial set-theoretical model in ZF+GCH and allows to carry out nontrivial proof developments. Base normalization proof is surprisingly simple (modulo general metatheoretical properties of pure type systems) and has been fully formalized in vanilla Rocq (formerly Coq) without additional axioms.
entries.title_zh: 以 rank 为 sort 且含 Type-in-Type 的可靠纯类型系统
entries.summary_zh: 作者构造依赖类型纯类型系统，含循环公理 s:s，却仍强正规化；其避免 Girard 悖论的方式是不给 sort 配置一般 Π-形成规则，而按函数类型 rank 放置 sort。论文还报告归约复杂度为 TOWER-complete、可非一致表示任意初等递归函数、有 ZF+GCH 中非平凡集合论模型，且基础正规化证明已在不加额外公理的 vanilla Rocq 中形式化。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合类型论、证明助手与强规范化研究者。

entries.title_zh: 越恐慌，越是在喂养“心灵感应兽”
entries.summary_zh: James Eldred Pascoe 用“读心术”比喻模型从不同数学家的既有工作中拼接线索：若研究者因怕落后而把更多未发表想法交给 AI，而对话又可能进入训练数据，恐惧就会加剧竞争循环。作者同时认为这揭示了数学共同体内部协作不足，主张以谨慎、适度使用 AI、加强人与人交流和长期支持来维持认知自主；这是观点性评论，不是关于训练数据或模型来源的实证证明。本条因来源标题或摘录变化被标记为更新，以上概述依据当前提供的文章材料，不表示独立核验了新的进展。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合反思 AI 竞争压力、研究隐私与学术协作之间的关系，文章重点是共同体治理和个人选择。
entries.pragmatic_review: 明确哪些研究内容可输入工具，并增加同行交流，能降低不必要的恐慌。
entries.cynic_review: 训练数据如何使用取决于具体服务条款，文章的比喻不是普遍事实证明。
entries.paper_review: 这是立场鲜明的评论文章，未提供训练数据流向的实证研究。

entries.source_title: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
entries.source_excerpt: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
entries.title_zh: ai-job-search：用 Claude Code 辅助评估岗位与准备求职材料
entries.summary_zh: 该 MIT 许可仓库提供一套在本机运行的 Claude Code 求职工作流，涵盖岗位评估、按岗位调整简历、撰写求职信和面试准备，并组织了简历、公司研究、岗位抓取等模块。作者以自己 69 份定制申请、20 次首轮面试和最终签约的经历说明其用途，但这是个人自述，不是对求职效果的对照评估；使用时也要注意把简历和招聘往来交给代理所涉及的隐私与事实核验。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合想把重复求职步骤模块化的人参考其工作流结构，并检查本地运行、材料权限和输出核验方式。
entries.pragmatic_review: 岗位匹配、材料定制与面试准备被组织成一条可复用流程。
entries.cynic_review: 作者的成功经历是个案，不能据此承诺类似求职结果。
entries.paper_review: 仓库提供代码和测试目录，但求职成效没有独立比较研究。

entries.source_title: Unranking $S$-avoiding permutations with two forbidden offsets
entries.source_excerpt: Given a finite family of combinatorial objects with a total order, ranking asks for the position of a given object, and unranking asks for the object occupying a given position. Both provide algorithmic access to families too large to enumerate. Kagey gave a polynomial-time algorithm for several position-restricted families and left open the case of $\{-1,1\}$-avoiding permutations. We show that when $|S| = 2$, the graph of forbidden squares is $2$-regular, a disjoint union of cycles, and that fixing a prefix leaves only paths and untouched cycles. This yields polynomial-time prefix counting, ranking and unranking for every two-element set of offsets, covering $\{-1,1\}$. The same structure gives a short proof that the number of $\{-1,1\}$-avoiding permutations equals the $n$-th m\'enage number for odd $n$ and exceeds it by $2$ for even $n$, proving a conjecture recorded in the OEIS entry A354152.
entries.title_zh: 两个禁用偏移下 S-避免排列的排名与反排名
entries.summary_zh: 对禁用偏移集合 S 且 |S|=2 的排列，论文利用禁用格点图为若干不交循环的 2-正则结构，证明固定前缀后只剩路径和未触及的循环，从而得到多项式时间前缀计数、排名及反排名算法。对于 S={−1,1}，作者还证明奇数 n 时计数等于第 n 个 ménage 数，偶数 n 时多 2，解决 OEIS A354152 所记猜想。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合组合算法与排列模式研究者，兼具计数恒等式与可计算操作。
entries.pragmatic_review: 把结构分解用于多项式时间 rank/unrank，并解决一个具体猜想。
entries.cynic_review: 算法复杂度常数与实现规模需看详细分析。
entries.paper_review: 摘要给出核心图结构、算法结论和精确计数公式。

entries.source_title: Will it be a golden age or a dark age for mathematics (and science)?
entries.source_excerpt: [This is a guest post by Francesco Maggi. This blog post was initially written in a different file format and converted using AI. — T.] Large language models (LLMs) and the research systems built around them (and commonly known as “artificial intelligence”) have demonstrated remarkable abilities in generating mathematical proofs. While the quality and limits […]
entries.title_zh: 数学与科学将迎来黄金时代还是黑暗时代？
entries.summary_zh: Francesco Maggi 的客座文章认为，LLM 生成证明的能力是真实且值得认真审查的，但部分重要 Lean 证明可能长达数十万行，机器生成的自然语言解释又可能不忠实或难以理解；因此形式正确与人类理解之间仍有鸿沟。作者把未来分为两种风险／机会：AI 扩大科研能力并培育新一代 STEM 人才，或让知识生产集中于少数机构、产出脱离人的理解；文章主张以独立审查、教育和开放协作影响走向。这是作者的政策与价值论述，不是对未来的定量预测；帖子也注明原文格式曾经 AI 转换。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合结合形式化证明、数学教育和科研治理，思考 AI 提高产出后如何维持可理解性与人才发展。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可把证明审查、可读性和人才培养作为 AI 科研制度设计的具体目标。
entries.cynic_review: 黄金／黑暗两种情景是规范性框架，技术与社会演变尚不确定。
entries.paper_review: 文章引用近期 AI 证明案例提出问题，但不构成对这些证明的独立认证。

entries.source_title: Geometry-Aware Latent Representation Learning for Drag Coefficient Prediction of Irregular Particles
entries.source_excerpt: Predicting the drag coefficient $C_\mathrm{d}$ of irregular particles requires representing their complex three-dimensional geometry in a form suitable for predictive models. Empirical drag correlations and many data-driven models represent particle geometry through a small set of hand-crafted shape descriptors. Geometric differences omitted by these descriptors are unavailable to the predictor. We propose a variational autoencoder-multilayer perceptron (VAE-MLP) framework that learns a latent representation directly from voxelized particle geometry. Geometry reconstruction and drag coefficient prediction jointly guide the learning of this representation. We compare VAE-MLP with a descriptor-based MLP (Descriptor-MLP) and established empirical correlations using CFD data for synthetic particle geometries at Reynolds numbers of 10--200. When the evaluated geometric variations are represented in the training data, the two learned models achieve comparable accuracy for regular ellipsoids, while VAE-MLP yields lower errors for irregular particles. entries.title_zh: 面向不规则颗粒阻力预测的几何感知潜在表示
entries.summary_zh: 作者提出 VAE-MLP，从体素化三维颗粒几何学习潜在表示，并联合训练几何重建与阻力系数预测；在 Re=10–200 的合成颗粒 CFD 数据上与形状描述符模型及经验关联式比较。规则椭球表现相近，不规则颗粒上潜在模型误差更低；训练中排除高阶表面扰动时，模型在五次测试中均优于描述符模型，最强扰动下相对误差为 4.97% 对 9.88%。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合颗粒流与科学机器学习读者评估直接编码几何是否胜过手工特征。
entries.pragmatic_review: 在未见几何扰动上报告了具体且重复的误差优势。
entries.cynic_review: 证据来自合成几何与限定雷诺数，外部实验迁移尚不确定。
entries.paper_review: 对比设计和指标明确，数据生成与统计不确定性需阅读全文。

entries.source_title: DeepLethe/FDE-Gym
entries.source_excerpt: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery FDE-Gym tests whether an agent can do the work of a forward-deployed engineer: enter a customer's running environment, find out what matters there, make the decisions the job needs, and ship a system that holds up in production. Paper: arXiv:2610.22350 · Leaderboard: https://fde-gym.com/paper This repository holds the original task of each of the 20 scenarios. What is here cases/ / engagement.json title, what the… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/DeepLethe/FDE-Gym.
entries.title_zh: FDE-Gym：AI 交付的最后一公里
entries.summary_zh: FDE-Gym 是一个评测代理能否进入客户运行环境、判断关键需求、作出决策并交付可投入生产系统的基准，材料称其论文编号为 arXiv:2610.22350。数据集页面包含 20 个原始场景；另有 75 个变体只用于排行榜评测，参考解答也未公开。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 它把代理评测放进银行、医院、制造等具体业务环境，并将交付效果与利益相关者沟通成本结合，适合研究者分析长程代理任务的设定和评分方式。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可先阅读场景说明和评分定义，挑选一个原始任务检查评测流程；若要使用受限案例文件，需先接受访问条件。
entries.cynic_review: 页面称该分数是相对于基线和参考解答的归一化业务提升再减去沟通成本，因而结果依赖场景、评分锚点及成本设定。
entries.paper_review: 摘录列出论文编号、20 个场景目录和评分方法，但没有论文正文或实测结果；75 个变体与参考解答未公开，不能据此独立复核排行榜表现。

project_insight.translation_zh: FDE-Gym 测试代理能否承担前向部署工程师的工作：进入客户运行环境，查明关键事项，作出工作所需决策，并交付能在生产中稳定运行的系统。该仓库保存 20 个场景的原始任务；基准还包括 75 个只用于排行榜评分的变体，参考解答不公开。数据文件需接受 LICENSE.md 中的条件后访问，其中包括不得在组织外分享、不得公开评分器/参考事实/解答，以及不得将文件用于模型训练。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: FDE-Gym 用带有客户资料、模拟服务和评分器的业务场景评估代理的端到端交付表现。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先阅读论文和数据集访问条件，确认所在组织能接受许可限制；再查看公开场景目录与 FDE-Gym harness 说明，按页面提供的流程运行一个原始案例，并记录其与基线及评分锚点的关系。不要公开案例文件、评分器、参考事实或解答。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 数据集文件需要登录并接受访问条款，且禁止组织外分享相关文件、公开评分器/参考事实/解答以及将文件纳入模型训练数据。页面称基准共有 95 个任务，但变体为保留评测用途而未公开；因此仅凭当前摘录无法重现完整排行榜比较。
use_cases_zh: 研究代理在信息不完整的业务环境中如何收集需求、联系利益相关者并交付系统。
比较同一场景不同任务指令层级（L0 至 L3）对代理执行方式的影响。
检查基准如何把生产流量表现、参考解答和利益相关者沟通成本纳入评分。

entries.source_title: On Niu's Conjecture for Two-Station Tandem Queues
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we prove a long standing conjecture in queueing theory made by Niu (1980): in a two-station tandem queueing system with constant service time (c) at station 1, the stationary average waiting time at station 2 is nonincreasing in c. Two very different proofs are provided: one for the general case and one for a special case in which the arrival process is Poisson and the service time at station 2 is exponential.
entries.title_zh: Niu 双站串联队列猜想的证明
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明 Niu 于 1980 年提出的双站串联队列猜想：若第一站服务时间为常数 c，则第二站稳态平均等待时间随 c 增大而不增。作者提供两种不同证明，一种处理一般情形，另一种针对到达过程为 Poisson 且第二站服务时间为指数分布的特例。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合排队论读者关注上游服务时长如何影响下游拥堵，以及经典单调性猜想的证明方法。
entries.pragmatic_review: 单调关系可用于分析串联系统中的服务配置与等待时间。
entries.cynic_review: 结论针对稳态平均等待时间，不能直接推出其他绩效指标也单调。
entries.paper_review: 摘要明确主猜想与两种证明适用范围，技术假设需读全文。

entries.source_title: Introducing TorchNeuron: Native PyTorch backend for AWS Trainium
entries.source_excerpt: AWS 宣布 TorchNeuron，一个面向 Trainium 的开源原生 PyTorch 后端，10 月 20 日起以 Apache 2.0 公开 Beta 发布于 github.com/aws-neuron/torch-neuronx。
entries.title_zh: TorchNeuron：让 PyTorch 代码原生运行在 AWS Trainium 上
entries.summary_zh: PyTorch 与 AWS 宣布开源 TorchNeuron 后端，让现有 PyTorch 模型代码和工具以标准 PyTorch 设备方式使用 Trainium；公告称其支持 eager 执行（含自适应模式）、生产场景的 torch.compile、自定义 NKI 内核，以及用 torch.profiler 将框架事件对应到硬件执行。首发面向 Trainium2 和 Trainium3，计划以 Apache-2.0 公开 Beta 发布；这可降低软件接口迁移摩擦，但性能和算子覆盖仍需按目标模型实测。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合评估 PyTorch 工作负载迁移到 AWS 专用加速器时的接口、调试和性能分析路径。
entries.pragmatic_review: 标准设备接口和 profiler 集成有助于沿用现有 PyTorch 工作流。
entries.cynic_review: 后端可用不等于所有模型算子都具备成熟覆盖。
entries.paper_review: 官方公告列明支持模式，但发布后仍需核验 Beta 的性能与稳定性。

entries.source_title: Who Speaks, Who Authorizes, Who Acts? Understanding Trust Boundaries in Multi-Agent LLMs
entries.source_excerpt: Multi-agent LLM systems exchange messages before acting through tools, but message delivery, signing authority, and tool-side enforcement are separate trust boundaries. We represent them as communication, authorization, and execution structures, and use the authority cut to characterize the smallest independently compromised signer coalition that can construct a policy-valid false-claim proof under stated assumptions. Controlled paired hidden-state studies reveal four distinctions. First, no fixed-message routing contrast across four models meets the prespecified large-effect criterion; when relays rewrite messages, executed false-state action rates vary by model and route configuration. Second, presented source-identity cues do not uniformly increase protected-action selection across three models. Third, on invalid-proof cases, Nemotron and Llama request protected actions in 52.1% and 54.2% of trials, respectively, yet a deterministic tool gate commits none: request-level and commitment-level safety readouts diverge. Finally, a separate single-model authorization check shows that a false claim with a policy-valid compromised-signer p
entries.title_zh: 多智能体 LLM 中谁发言、谁授权、谁执行？
entries.summary_zh: 论文把通信、授权与工具执行视为独立信任边界，并以 authority cut 衡量可伪造策略有效错误声明所需被攻破的最小签名者联盟。受控实验发现伪造身份提示并不会一致地提高受保护动作选择；更关键的是，Nemotron 与 Llama 在无效证明场景下分别有 52.1% 和 54.2% 请求受保护动作，但确定性工具门禁最终一次也未执行，说明请求率与实际提交率不能混为一谈。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合构建多智能体工具安全与授权系统的研究者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 实验显示执行侧门禁可阻断模型提出的危险请求。
entries.cynic_review: 结论受限于所测模型、路由和威胁设定，不能概括所有 agent。
entries.paper_review: 将权限请求与实际执行分开度量，安全指标设计有启发。

entries.source_title: "Deep lifts": Neural networks can generalize even with the dumbest optimizer
entries.source_excerpt: Given a labeled dataset $\{(x_i, y_i)\}_{i = 1}^n$, consider drawing a parameter vector $\hat{\theta}$ uniformly at random from those that interpolate the data within a width-$W$ depth-$D$ ReLU architecture with continuous weights bounded within $[-M, M]$. We study the generalization properties of $\hat{\theta}$ in the case where the dataset can, in fact, be explained by a smaller $w$-by-$d$ ReLU network. Despite the obliviousness of the selection rule for $\hat{\theta}$, it adaptively generalizes at the rate $\tilde O\left(\frac{wdWD}{n}\right)$, rather than being governed by the VC dimension of the full $W$-by-$D$ hypothesis class. The reason is due to a particular inductive bias in ReLU networks: the $w$-by-$d$ parameter *witnesses* an exponential volume of $W$-by-$D$ interpolating parameters, which dwarfs the volume of poorly generalizing parameters (conditioned on interpolation). We explicitly construct this set of near-equivalent $W$-by-$D$ parameters by a proof technique called *deep lifting*, and then tie the achievable volume to stability properties of the $w$-by-$d$ witness. Examples show that these techniques allow us to co
entries.title_zh: “深层提升”：即使优化器很笨，神经网络也能泛化
entries.summary_zh: 研究在可插值的宽深 ReLU 网络参数中均匀随机选取解时，若数据本可由更小网络解释，泛化误差仍可按小网络规模而非整个假设类 VC 维度控制。作者用 deep lifting 构造大量近似等价的大网络参数，说明小网络见证解对应的良好插值参数体积可能压过泛化差的解。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合学习理论读者理解架构参数空间体积如何形成隐式归纳偏置。
entries.pragmatic_review: 结果挑战“随机插值必然按大模型复杂度泛化”的直觉。
entries.cynic_review: 结论依赖数据可由较小 ReLU 网络解释及特定均匀抽样设定。
entries.paper_review: 理论主张清晰，速率中的维度因子和适用条件需阅读全文。

entries.source_title: black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy
entries.source_excerpt: diffusion-single-file · comfyui · image-generation · image-editing · flux · flux-3 · black-forest-labs · image-to-image · en · base_model:black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein · base_model:finetune:black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein · license:other · region:us
entries.title_zh: FLUX 3 Image Klein ComfyUI 模型文件包
entries.summary_zh: 这是为 ComfyUI 重新打包的 FLUX 3 Image Klein 图像生成与编辑模型文件，支持文本生成、单图编辑和最多10张参考图的多图组合，并可在提示中用边界框引导元素位置。页面建议先用 prompt upsampler 将简短请求扩写成完整场景描述，并给出不同精度文件大小及显卡提示；仓库需要接受访问条件，模型使用 FLUX Kommunity License。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 对需要本地 ComfyUI 图像生成或多参考图编辑的个人用户，模型将生成、编辑和布局引导放在同一工作流中，且材料列出了量化版本与文件配置，便于按硬件规划。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可按显存和硬件选择精度版本，先从 ComfyUI 提供的工作流及 prompt upsampler 入手测试生成和编辑效果。
entries.cynic_review: 页面称 int8 文件可运行于8 GB显存显卡，但完整工作流还需要文本编码器、prompt upsampler 和自动编码器，实际资源需求不应只看主模型文件。
entries.paper_review: 材料给出模型组成、采样参数、文件大小和使用说明，但没有独立基准或可复核的效果评估，且文件访问需先接受条件。

project_insight.translation_zh: FLUX 3 Image Klein 是一个 5.6B 参数的图像模型，可根据提示生成图像并编辑图像，支持最多10张参考图；其中5.6B指图像 Transformer，文本编码器另计。这个仓库为 ComfyUI 重新打包了 distilled 和 base Transformer、文本编码器、prompt upsampler 和图像自动编码器，提供 BF16、int8、NVFP4 等版本。模型支持文本生成、单参考图编辑、多参考图生成、提示中的边界框布局引导和图像内文字渲染。页面建议始终使用 prompt upsampler 或其他 LLM 将短提示扩写成完整场景描述；边界框只是位置与尺度引导，不是硬像素蒙版。模型采用 FLUX Kommunity License，仓库文件需接受 Hugging Face 访问条件后获取。

entries.source_title: MGE-PO: Entropy-Aware Credit Assignment for Mathematical Reasoning
entries.source_excerpt: GRPO assigns the same group-relative advantage to equally rewarded responses within a question, leaving their generation uncertainty unused. We introduce MGE-PO, centered on four-quadrant (4Q) advantage shaping that combines verified correctness with rollout generation entropy. Correctness determines the sign of an additional correction, while entropy controls its magnitude: lower-entropy successes receive larger bonuses and higher-entropy failures receive larger penalties. An online entropy-based question curriculum supports this credit rule using cached rollout measurements. At the final checkpoint after eight training epochs on Qwen3-8B-Base, adding 4Q across three policy optimization settings yields absolute gains of 3.23-3.69% in six-benchmark macro avg@32 and 4.24-11.06% in macro pass@32. On Qwen2.5-7B-Base, the complete configuration raises four-benchmark macro avg@32 from 41.5% to 45.4%.

entries.source_title: How Well Can LLMs Verbalize Mathematical Formulas? A Multi-Domain Evaluation
entries.source_excerpt: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities across natural language tasks. But their ability to generate accurate written verbalizations of mathematical formulas has not been systematically evaluated. Such verbalization is important for text-to-speech systems supporting audio-based learning and visually impaired users. We evaluated five state-of-the-art LLMs across six scientific domains and constructed Read-Aloud Math, a balanced multi-domain corpus with LaTeX formulas, manually validated simple and extended transcriptions, multiple variants, textual context, domain labels, and formula complexity levels. Using multi-reference BLEU, GPT-5.2 achieved the highest score for simple transcriptions (75.9% without context, 64.9% with context), although without context it did not significantly outperform Grok 4.1 Fast or Claude Sonnet 4.5. Claude Sonnet 4.5 achieved the highest score for extended transcriptions without context (36.5%), and Grok 4.1 Fast with context (48.8%). entries.source_title: Identity crisis on tightly $C^{(2)}$-compact cardinals
entries.source_excerpt: Bagaria and Goldberg asked if $\kappa$ being tightly $C^{(n)}$-compact implies $\kappa\in C^{(n+1)}$ for natural numbers $n\ge 1$? Usuba gave a negative answer for $n=1$. In this paper we give a negative answer for $n=2$.

entries.source_title: Markoff spectra of Hecke groups
entries.source_excerpt: We study the initial discrete parts of the Markoff spectra of Hecke groups of index $q\ge 5$. Using a digit expansion associated with geodesics and a Perron-type formula, we classify all bi-infinite digit sequences whose Markoff values lie at or below the first accumulation point. We obtain explicit formulas for the discrete spectral values and identify the sequences realizing them, including those attaining the first accumulation point. We also prove that the infinite family of discrete values increases strictly to this point. Our results recover Vulakh's description of the initial discrete spectra through an explicit symbolic approach.
entries.title_zh: Hecke 群的 Markoff 谱

entries.source_title: Space-filling curves and small-ball probabilities for the Kloosterman process
entries.source_excerpt: We construct explicitly a space-filling curve in the support of the limiting Kloosterman process, using the planar partial-sum curve of the Rudin--Shapiro sequence. The qualitative existence statement was previously attributed to J. Bober by Kowalski. The resulting curve is a closed, $1/2$-H\"older continuous loop whose image contains a specified triangle of area $1/128$. Its Fourier coefficients are purely imaginary and satisfy $|\widehat f(h)|\leq(2\pi|h|)^{-1}$ for $h\ne 0$. We also prove a uniform lower bound for small balls centred at closed $1/2$-H\"older curves with a fixed coefficient bound, of the form $\exp\{-C\varepsilon^{-2}\log^2(2/\varepsilon)\}$. Known functional convergence then gives a quantitative lower bound for the limiting proportion of two-parameter Kloosterman paths approximating the constructed loop.
entries.title_zh: Kloosterman 过程的空间填充曲线与小球概率
entries.summary_zh: 论文用 Rudin–Shapiro 序列的平面部分和曲线，显式构造一条位于极限 Kloosterman 过程支撑集中的闭合 1/2-Hölder 曲线，其像包含面积为 1/128 的三角形；傅里叶系数为纯虚数，并满足给定的 1/|h| 上界。作者还证明，以满足固定系数界的闭合 1/2-Hölder 曲线为中心的小球概率有统一下界，量级为 exp(−C ε⁻² log²(2/ε))，再利用已知函数型收敛推导二参数 Kloosterman 路径逼近该曲线的比例下界。

entries.source_title: A Conditional No-Hair Theorem for Transformers: How Language Models Forget Their Prompt
entries.source_excerpt: We ask how much an autoregressive transformer retains of its prompt after generating $t$ tokens. Consider two different prompts followed by the same continuation text, so that any difference in their hidden states comes from the prompt alone, and we find that the distance between their hidden states decays approximately as a power law $t^{-\alpha}$, where $\alpha=1$ is the rate at which a fixed prompt's share of uniform attention shrinks and smaller values mean longer memory. Trained models forget fast ($\alpha\approx0.55$--$0.7$), untrained ones slowly ($\alpha\approx0.2$--$0.5$). We prove that this offset is $O\big(P(\log t)^{L-1}/t\big)$ for a prompt of length $P$ and depth $L$. The bound holds for finite-depth pre-LN softmax transformers with bounded attention logits, under one additional condition: the pre-norm activations stay away from zero. The mechanism is geometric: the prompt's direct influence is diluted as the context grows, and \emph{relay} --- continuation tokens passing on what earlier tokens read from the prompt --- can only add logarithmic factors. entries.source_title: Optimized linear multistep methods for stiff problems
entries.source_excerpt: We design and test several new optimized linear multistep methods for stiff problems. Each method is A-stable, implicit, and second-order accurate. We focus on achieving the smallest possible error constant while also ensuring that stiff modes are damped. We recover some known optimal L-stable three- and four-step methods, and provide new and improved five-step methods. We also develop new methods that are not L-stable but provide a prescribed rate of damping in the infinitely stiff limit. Variable-step-size formulae are also provided for some of the new methods. Numerical tests demonstrate that the improved error constants lead to improved accuracy.

entries.source_title: Measuring Empowerment from Offline Data for Intrinsically Motivated Exploration
entries.source_excerpt: Large, unlabeled datasets of prior experience have become increasingly available for agentic tasks in domains such as robotics and coding. A common recipe for these tasks is to train a policy using the prior data, and then further improve it with online rollouts. But while much work has studied how to use both the offline and online data for policy extraction, far less work has been done to understand how the prior data can be used to efficiently \textit{explore} during the online learning phase. Previous work has attempted to formalize this idea by defining the \textit{empowerment}, a measure of how many future states an agent can realize; states with higher empowerment require more exploration as there are more futures to explore. However, existing methods for estimating empowerment require online policy rollouts in the environment. We propose the first method for estimating empowerment from unlabeled prior data, without any environment interaction. entries.source_title: The pattern of consistency strength for membership in a computably enumerable set
entries.source_excerpt: Every computable preorder relation on the natural numbers is the order of consistency strength for the membership assertions "$n\in A$" in some computably enumerable set $A$. Moreover, for every computably enumerable list of theories $T_0,T_1,T_2,\ldots$, each extending PA, there is a computably enumerable set $A$ such that each $T_n$ is equiconsistent over PA with the membership assertion $n\in A$. And similarly for both results when using instead the nonmembership assertions $n\notin A$.

entries.source_title: Poisson-Dirichlet statistics for the log-modulus of the Riemann zeta function on expanding intervals near the critical line
entries.source_excerpt: For $T > 0$ large, let $\tau$ be uniformly distributed on $[T,2T]$ and let $\sigma = \sigma(T)$ be a deterministic real part approaching $1/2$ from the right. For the Riemann zeta function $\zeta$, we study the Gibbs measure with density proportional to $|\zeta(\sigma + \mathrm{i}\tau + \mathrm{i} h)|^{\beta}$ on $I_{\theta} := [ - (\log{T})^{\theta},(\log{T})^{\theta}]$, for every $\theta > 0$ and $\beta > 0$. As $\beta$ increases, the Gibbs measure increasingly favors positions where $|\zeta|$ is large, providing a way to study the spatial organization of extreme values. Under explicit conditions on the rate at which $\sigma$ approaches the critical line, a phase transition is established at the critical inverse temperature $\beta_{c}(\theta) := 2\sqrt{1 + \theta}$. The limiting distribution of the correlation (or overlap) between the field values at two positions sampled from the Gibbs measure is concentrated at $0$ when $\beta \leq \beta_{c}(\theta)$, and assigns masses $\beta_{c}(\theta)/\beta$ and $1 - \beta_{c}(\theta)/\beta$ to $0$ and $1$, respectively, when $\beta > \beta_{c}(\theta)$. Joint convergence of the overlaps is al

entries.source_title: FederatedBytes: Tokenizer-Free, Byte-Level Small Language Models for Efficient Multimodal Federated Learning
entries.source_excerpt: Federated Learning (FL) is a powerful machine learning framework that allows building a global model from the contributions of multiple, distributed clients, while ensuring the privacy of their local data. However, its heavy computational and communication overheads challenge its use for contemporary AI workloads such as natural language processing (NLP) and multimodal analysis. For this reason, this paper presents a novel small language model that leverages byte-level text and multimodal data processing, enhanced by a linear attention mechanism, to enable manageable Federated Learning of NLP and multimodal analysis tasks. The proposed model, nicknamed FederatedBytes, manages to process text and any other data types, including images, by treating its input as a mere sequence of bytes, while its lean linear attention mechanism allows abating the overall memory and computational footprint. To prove the effectiveness of the proposed model we have carried out an extensive performance evaluation on sentiment analysis tasks in multilingual and multimodal settings over the Multilingual Amazon Reviews and ScienceQA datasets. For general kernels, the closed convex hull of the averaging densities obtained from all scales and the dual unit ball is a complete invariant of the full maximal operator. entries.source_title: Continual Test-Time Learning with Evolution Strategies
entries.source_excerpt: Large language models increasingly operate in open-ended environments, where they are expected to continually adapt to evolving tasks and distributions, often without access to external supervision. Existing continual learning approaches rely on external supervision, such as labeled data, demonstrations, or reward signals, which can be costly or unavailable in practice. Test-time adaptation removes this dependence by learning from self-generated supervision, but existing methods derive that supervision from the single policy being updated, so once the policy drifts, its own learning signal drifts with it, leading to policy collapse, degraded reasoning, and catastrophic forgetting. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Evolution Strategy Reinforcement Learning (ESRL)}, a continual test-time learning framework that draws its self-generated supervision from a population of policies instead of the single policy being trained. entries.source_title: Complete regular dessins: the nonmetacyclic case
entries.source_excerpt: We classify regular dessins on $K_{2^e,2^f}$ with nonmetacyclic colour-preserving automorphism group, retaining the two specified vertex rotations. We give nonredundant presentations and exact counts in both the abelian and nonabelian Frattini cases. For orientation- and colour-preserving isomorphisms, the number is $2^{2e-2}+16$ when $e=f\ge4$ and $3\cdot2^{2f-3}+16$ when $e>f\ge4$, with explicit counts for all smaller exponents. The construction uses a parity criterion in the abelian case and a uniquely determined odd quadratic root with two lifts in the nonabelian case. A dessin in the classification is reflexible exactly when its Frattini subgroup is abelian. All symmetric classes are circular. We determine every circular subfamily, including its face orders and genera; the circular count is $2^e+8$ on the diagonal and $2^{f-2}(2^{f-1}+1)+8$ off the diagonal for $e\ge f\ge4$.

entries.summary_zh: 来源摘录称 Claude Cup 是一项全球构建竞赛，可追踪 Value/Token Ratio、参与实时排行榜，并在终端显示奖杯进度。材料仅提供一句简介，没有说明指标定义、计分方法、参赛规则或软件许可。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 若正在参加该竞赛，终端内的进度展示可能方便；对一般 AI 或数学科研用户，当前资料不足以判断排行榜指标是否有参考价值。
entries.pragmatic_review: 目前只能确认它提供终端排行榜与奖杯展示，摘录没有足够信息指导安装或用于日常工作。
entries.cynic_review: Value/Token Ratio 的定义和统计口径未见于材料，不能据此把排行榜名次当作模型或项目质量的可靠比较。
entries.paper_review: 材料没有论文、代码细节、计分验证或可复现的评测证据。

project_insight.translation_zh: Claude Cup 是一项全球构建竞赛，可追踪 Value/Token Ratio、参与实时排行榜，并在终端显示动态奖杯。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 围绕 Claude Cup 竞赛提供终端内的 Value/Token Ratio 追踪、实时排名和奖杯展示。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先查看 npm 页面中的完整说明、版本、许可和竞赛计分规则，再决定是否安装；使用前应确认 Value/Token Ratio 的计算方式及其数据来源。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 当前摘录只有简短宣传描述，未给出计分定义、安装方法、许可、数据采集方式或维护状态；名称中的 Claude 也不足以说明其与 Anthropic 官方产品的关系。
use_cases_zh: 参加 Claude Cup 时查看自己的竞赛指标与排名。
对比不同构建尝试的 Token 使用与竞赛所定义的价值指标，前提是先确认其计分口径。

entries.source_title: vectorize-io/hindsight
entries.source_excerpt: Hindsight: Agent Memory That Learns
entries.title_zh: Hindsight：会学习的智能体记忆系统
entries.summary_zh: Hindsight 面向会随时间积累信息的智能体记忆，提供 retain、recall、reflect 操作，并可通过客户端、LLM 包装器及 MCP 等方式接入。项目 README 声称其在 LongMemEval 上达到领先表现，并称部分基准结果已由 Virginia Tech Sanghani Center 和《华盛顿邮报》的研究合作者独立复现；这些是来源中的自述，摘录未提供具体实验数据。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合想为个人助手或研究代理增加跨会话记忆的人；文档列出本地部署、嵌入式用法和多种模型提供方，便于评估是否适合自己的数据与推理环境。
entries.pragmatic_review: retain/recall/reflect 的接口和本地部署路径清楚，可先用少量非敏感资料验证记忆检索效果。
entries.cynic_review: README 对优于 RAG 和领先基准表现的表述较强，但摘录未给出对比细节，而且完整能力可能依赖外部模型及其成本。
entries.paper_review: 材料链接了论文和动态基准页，并提到独立复现，但本摘录没有论文方法、结果表或复现配置可供核查。

project_insight.translation_zh: Hindsight：会学习的智能体记忆系统。项目称它专注于让智能体从长期交互中学习，而不只是回忆对话历史。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 为智能体提供信息写入、记忆检索和基于记忆生成回应的长期记忆服务。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先阅读安装与模型提供方文档，选择嵌入式方式或本地服务；用一组虚构或非敏感事实测试 retain、recall、reflect，并记录模型、延迟和答案准确性，再决定是否接入真实资料。
project_insight.limitations_zh: README 表明可使用本地及托管模型，但某些提供方需要凭据；托管 Hindsight Cloud 按用量计费。长期记忆涉及资料保留与访问控制，摘录没有说明其具体隐私和安全机制。项目的基准领先及生产使用情况来自项目材料，摘录未包含完整论文与复现细节。
use_cases_zh: 为个人研究助理保存项目背景、文献阅读记录，再按问题检索。
给本地或自托管智能体添加跨会话上下文，比较不同记忆策略的效果。
通过 MCP 或 LLM 包装器评估记忆能力对日常编码助手的帮助。

entries.source_title: Asymptotic dimension of graphs excluding an induced or fat minor
entries.source_excerpt: Asymptotic dimension is a large-scale invariant of metric spaces that was introduced by Gromov (1993). A major open problem in coarse graph theory asks whether, for every fixed graph $H$, the class of graphs excluding $H$ as a fat minor has bounded asymptotic dimension. A weaker conjecture asserts the same conclusion for graphs excluding $H$ as an induced minor. We substantially expand the range of graphs $H$ for which these conjectures are known to hold. Specifically, we prove bounded asymptotic dimension for the following classes of graphs: graphs excluding a fixed planar graph as a fat minor; and graphs excluding a fixed string graph as an induced minor. All of our results also hold for the stronger notion of Assouad--Nagata dimension, a refinement of asymptotic dimension. These results have a number of applications, two of which we mention here. First they imply that an induced minor-closed class is $\chi$-bounded if and only if it does not contain some Burling graph. Second they imply that, in graph classes excluding a fixed planar graph as an induced minor, treewidth is polynomial in maximum degree.
entries.title_zh: 排除诱导小图或胖小图次式的图类渐近维数
entries.summary_zh: 论文推进粗图论中的渐近维数问题，证明排除固定平面图作为胖 minor 的图类，以及排除固定字符串图作为诱导 minor 的图类，都具有有界渐近维数；结果也对更强的 Assouad–Nagata 维数成立。应用包括：诱导 minor 闭图类具有 χ-有界性，当且仅当它不包含某个 Burling 图；并且排除固定平面诱导 minor 的图类中，树宽可被最大度的多项式控制。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合图论与度量几何读者，连接小图排除条件、维数不变量、染色界和树宽界。
entries.pragmatic_review: 多个应用展示渐近维数界可以导出组合结构限制。
entries.cynic_review: 结论依赖具体胖 minor 或诱导 minor 排除类，范围不可混用。
entries.paper_review: 摘要列出两个新图类及推论，证明中的图类条件需阅读全文核对。

entries.source_title: Causal Edit Serialization
entries.source_excerpt: Standard autoregressive language models generate text sequentially, but revision requires referring back to tokens in the input context or those already generated. Causal Edit Serialization (CES) is introduced as a framework for expressing such revisions within the same causal token stream. Special pointer tokens are paired with predicted source addresses, allowing insertion, deletion, replacement, copying and movement to be localized explicitly. A lightweight localization head and dual-index rotary position encoding support both address prediction and conditioning on previously emitted pointers, while retaining a standard causal attention mask. A pretraining procedure combines ordinary language modeling with serialized repairs derived from random corruptions, model-generated edits and repeated text. Across model scales and editing baselines, CES models demonstrate complete applied edits with modestly higher clean-text bits per byte than clean autoregressive models. Supervised and reinforcement-learning post-training provide a grammatical-error-correction proof of concept, producing more beneficial than harmful changes under reference
entries.title_zh: 因果编辑序列化
entries.summary_zh: CES 用专门指针 token 与源位置地址，把插入、删除、替换、复制和移动表示为自回归序列中的显式编辑操作。模型保留因果注意力，加入定位头和双索引 RoPE，并以随机损坏、模型生成修改及重复文本构造修复预训练数据；实验报告可执行编辑完整度提升但干净文本 bits-per-byte 略高，语法纠错微调提供概念验证。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合文本编辑模型和自回归解码研究者了解显式编辑动作表示。
entries.pragmatic_review: 把回看和局部修改纳入因果生成形式，编辑操作具有可定位性。
entries.cynic_review: 摘要显示语言建模代价略增，复杂编辑任务收益范围待评估。
entries.paper_review: 结构与训练方案清楚，质量—效率权衡和基线细节需阅读全文。
